The axis system calls which could represent the characteristics of normal behaviors are extracted by a sequences extracting factor. The improved algorithm measures the interestingness of sequences of system calls by involving the axis system calls, then train and tests the relevant sequences which we are concerned about. Experimental results demonstrate that the computing cost of training and testing in the new way has a reduction of 70% than the standard algorithm.

articleTitle: Monte-Carlo Simulation for the Reliability Analysis of Multi-status Network System Based on Breadth First Search
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In general engineering network system, the transformation of the working state, from safety to failure, of unit and system is gradual. And there is an intermediate state between the states of being completely safety and completely failing. On the basis of "safety-intermediate-failure" three-stage working mode, this paper divides it into two-stage mode: "safety-non safety" and "non failure-failure", and realizes the calculation of connective reliability for network system by traditional disjoint algorithm. The concept of reliability vector is put forward, which includes in three indexes such as probability of safety, probability of intermediate and probability of failure for engineering structures. In order to solve the non-polynomial increase hard problem of reliability calculation for super-large network system with intermediate state, according to the breadth first search technology of graph theory, an algorithm for estimate of the network connectivity is presented to evaluate reliability of network by Monte Carlo simulation. The analysis of an example in a certain network system demonstrates the effectiveness and applicability of the established algorithm.

articleTitle: Sub-pixel Edge Detection Based on Polynomial Fitting for Line-Matrix CCD Image
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In order to improve the precision of the line-matrix CCD edge detecting system, a sub-pixel edge detecting method based on polynomial fitting is proposed. According to the step jump characteristic of the image edge gray degree and grads, it can determine the pixel boundary of the CCD image through edge automatic detecting algorithm. Based on this, we can use the polynomial fitting method to make sub-pixel subdivision of the edge position of the image, and carry out polynomial fitting of the edge signal. Finally, use the least square method to compare the second order curve which is obtained by fitting with the threshold level, and then use it to get the formula. We can use the formula to work out the accurate position of the edge point, thereby achieve the sub-pixel edge positioning precision. The experimental results and analysis show that, compared with the threshold level comparison method, the straight line fitting method has more advantages, such as high repeated precision, good stability and so on. It can restrain the influence of random noise effectively, so it can detect the edge position of one-dimensional image effectively.

articleTitle: Simulation Investigation on the Thermo-mechanical Coupling of the QT 300 Piston
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper, the half solid model of the QT300 piston for the marine diesel engine was established by Pro/E software, and the finite element analysis model was also established by using ANSYS software. The thermal- mechanical coupling stress field and temperature field were obtained with finite element method. The calculating results indicated that the highest temperature was 389.692°C, occurring in the top of the piston, and that the highest coupling stress was 406MPa, locating in inner boundary above the piston pin hole. The maximum displacement value was 0.583 mm appearing on the main thrust surface of the piston head.

articleTitle: An Analysis on the Negative Effects of E-government Information Opening: Case Study of Coal Administrative Information Opening in Shanxi Province
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Based on coal administrative information opening in Shanxi Province, the paper reviews the related domestic and foreign studies on the effect of e-government information opening, collects a large number of data through the questionnaires from the view of negative effects diffusion and information communication, deduces the primary influence factors of negative effects of e-government information opening which are based on the analysis of the data, constructs a model of negative effects of e-government information opening on the principle of rationalization.

articleTitle: Environmental Influence on Precision and Accuracy Estimating Gene Effect by Molecular Marker Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In the past, the gene effect causing the variation of quantitative trait was researched as a whole body. For avoiding the QTL mapping, the molecular marker regression was used to research the quantitative trait controlled by polygene. A general analysis model using molecular marker material was established for estimating the gene effect controlling quantitative trait, and the mathematical relation between genepsilas relative effect and molecular marker genotype was found. However, the environmental influence on precision and accuracy estimating gene effect by molecular marker regression model was not discussed. In this research, quantitative trait genetic model and molecular marker regression model were established to simulate the environmental influence on precision and accuracy estimating gene effect, the result showed that precision and accuracy were reduced with the increasing of environmental effect, ignoring of main gene loci and augment of the number of gene loci controlling quantitative trait. Therefore, for increasing the precision and accuracy estimating gene effect, enough number of gene loci and main QTL (quantitative trait locus) should be considered in estimating the polygenic effects, and the levels in orthogonal rows should also be considered as different allele combinations of animal samples, other than individuals.

articleTitle: Broadcasting on the BSN-Hypercube Network
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Biswapped network(BSN) is a recently proposed network model of parallel computing, which is built of 2n copies of an n-nodes basic network, and its basic network may be hypercube, mesh and other networks, hence we can construct BSN-Hypercube and BSN-Mesh by using hypercube and mesh as basic network. BSN uses a simple rule for connectivity to ensure its regularity and some topological properties of BSN have been investigated. In this paper, we show the topological properties of the BSN-Hypercube network and present an efficient broadcasting scheme on the BSN-Hypercube network

articleTitle: Two-Period Price Management for Closed-Loop Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In a closed-loop supply chain, the manufacturer makes new products and sells them by the retailer in the first period, reclaims used-products by the retailer in the second period. But the supply of used-products is affected not only by the amount of new products that sold to the consumer market, but also by the end-customerpsilas willingness that is affected by the difference between the end-customerpsilas valuation for the used-product and the collecting price of the used-product. In this paper, considering the relationship of the consumer market of the new products and the supply market of the used-products, the end-customerpsilas valuation for the used-product, we present two-period price decisions for the new product and the used-product, show a numerical example to illustrate the optimal results and give the analysis of the optimal results. By our study, we find that the manufacturer and the retailer must pay more attention to the observation of the end-customerpsilas sensitivity coefficient of the collecting price and the end-customerpsilas valuation for the used-products in order to obtain the expected profit.

articleTitle: A New Ellipse Detector Based on Hough Transform
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper a novel ellipse detector that can be used in real image processing is proposed. Since the drawbacks of standard Hough transform (SHT) and other ellipse detection methods such as least square method require large computation and the large storage, the new method is proposed to reduce computation cost and storage requirement. First, edge image is divided into several sub-images by the properties of ellipse, and then point pairs are chosen from the sub-images to calculate the parameters of ellipses. Second a data merging method is used to process the parameters. At last, both synthetic and real images are processed with the proposed method, the experimental results show that the proposed detector is capable of detecting ellipse features with superior accuracy under various image conditions.

articleTitle: Prediction Model of Stock Prices Based on Correlative Analysis and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: There is a low forecasting accuracy when we forecast the price date by the traditional BP network only considering a single closing price as the time series vector. But, if we try to add other factors vector to the BP network input vector, we will find there are low training accuracy caused by the a large number of factors .In order to solve the issues raised above ,the author sets up a two-step Forecast approach with the combination between SOFM network and BP network. First, we uses the Gray Correlation Analysis to choose the set of variable which can describe the characteristics of the state of the stock market from a number of technical indicators. Then we can classify the state of stock market by the SOFM network which has the capacity of self-organizing classification. And base on the classification, we use BP network to accurately predict . The results of experiment showed that the predictive accuracy of SOFM-BP model is more improved than that of traditional BP neural network model. And it is feasible and effective to forecast China’s stock market by SOFM-BP model, which has a prospective future

articleTitle: Bolt Parametric Design System Development Based on ProEngineer
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: 3D modeling softwares are widely used in many engineering field such as mining machinery, aerospace, transportation and petrochemical. Bolt is a common part for engineering, but for some bolts it is still tedious to build the 3D models. To build the accurate 3D model of bolt is significant for finite element analysis and digital simulation. For this reason a design system was developed with VC and Protoolkit, the interface of it is the same as the platform. In order to improve the reliability and stabilization, the link of the software and platform is seamless. The application of the software shown that using the software can improve the work efficiency and decrease the labor intensity of designers.

articleTitle: Style Translation for Line Drawings Based on Mesh and Evolution
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper presents a new method to translate style of line drawings. Based on the theory of shape evolution, we translated the style of line drawings by transforming the control points of each stroke and deforming the mesh of the position-feature points of all strokes in a drawing. In this way, we adjusted the appearance and arrangement of strokes and obtained different styles of the drawing. Compared to previous work, the style of line drawings is considered not only the geometric attributes of each stroke but also distribution and arrangement of all stokes. Some examples are illustrated in the end of the paper to demonstrate our method.

articleTitle: Context-Based Approach for Covering Ambiguity Resolution in Chinese Word Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Covering ambiguity is a vital issue in Chinese word segmentation. Challenges are that disambiguation is depending on the contextual information. This paper collected contextual information statistics of covering ambiguity words and found a context calculation mode by using log likelihood ratio. A weighing calculation formula is designed for considering contextual informationpsilas window size and location and the influence of frequency on covering ambiguity. Based on this, two methods are used for disambiguation. One is using the maximum log likelihood ratio in contextual information; the other is using the maximum numerical value of the sum of respective log likelihood ratio under the situation of combination or separation in contextual information. 14 frequently appeared covering ambiguous words are used as examples. The average accuracy of the former method reaches 84.93%, and that of the latter reaches 95.60 %. The result of the experiment reveals that using the combination of contextual information is effective for disambiguation.

articleTitle: Highway Emergency Response System Based on GIS-T
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The fast response of highway emergency response system (HERS) need all departments cooperating with each other and real-time information sharing. In this paper, an integrated digit platform using geographical information system on transportation (GIS-T) is described. Based on the system analysis, the construction of HERS is established and the system functions are designed. Taking into account the distributed feature of existing system and the space properties of highway, the database system of platform is designed as space database, and the federated database system (FDBMS) is used to resolve heterogeneous distributed database. The global positioning system and the general packet radio service are adopted to realize the monitoring and locating of emergency vehicles, as well as the communication of platform. Finally, a prototype platform is developed using ArcGIS and Visual Basic according to the actual situation of JiLin highway.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of a Scalar Controlled Induction Motor Using Combined Inverter Machine Interaction in State Space
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Small displacement equations valid for small excursions about an operating point are established from the machine equations expressed in synchronously rotating reference frame. The conventional form of d-q model used for drive simulation has limitations in predicting the machine performance. It is possible that, accurate results for fundamental component of current and average torque near rated operating conditions are possible. This paper presents the modeling and simulation of inverter along with the induction motor in the synchronously rotating reference frame. Analysis of a state space model of inverter and induction motor drive system in synchronously rotating reference frame under variable speed control is given. This enables to determine the performance of variable speed drive with inverter in a closed loop which can be used for stability studies. The performance of this proposed scheme is presented by simulation in MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Remote Monitoring System in Wind Power Farm
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Wind power technology is becoming more and more mature, and taking an important position in the area of new energy development, it has an important value of development and utilization. In this paper, remote monitoring system in wind power farm is designed aim at the following problems: the production information of wind power farm can not be managed centralized, poor data consistency, data can not be shared, and so on. This system has been implemented and applied in HECIC Energy Co., Ltd. in Hebei Province.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Blind Hole Bolt Connection with 3-D Finite Element Approach
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The simple, reliable and feasible finite element model with three-dimensional solid elements about blind hole bolt connection based on ANSYS is proposed to obtain bolt pre-tensional effect. It uses node coupling to simulate the connection effect of the thread and applies preload to the bolt in order to achieve pre-tensional effect by using the pretension elements in ANSYS. The FE model would be of great benefit to avoid computation of iterative large non-linearity contact behaviour when using a series of bolt joints, where the bolts are loaded in tension. The proposed model is verified by theoretical computing and shows to have good agreement. The FEM simulation analysis and theoretical computing results indicate that the maximum stress occurs in the first tooth of the thread, which bears about 30 percent of the load, and stress distribution is the same as real thread connecting.

articleTitle: A Novel Man-Machine Cooperative Intelligent Reduction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Although the rough set theory can be deal with uncertain and incomplete knowledge with knowledge reasoning, but for complex systems and some new technology fields, simply rely on the machines learning, the results is not reliable. Absorb the expert knowledge, will help us to grasp the development of this field more accurately. This paper divided expert knowledge into two categories: the decisive expert knowledge and the expertspsila knowledge for reference, then proposed a novel man-machine cooperative intelligent reduction algorithm (RAEK) to search the minimum reduction based on the different status of expert knowledge. Finally, the empirical analysis result on the micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS) field shows that the RAEK algorithm is feasible and efficient.

articleTitle: Model Analysis of Game on Acting of Securities Investment Fund Company
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Institutional investors of fund mainly include fund company and securities trader and social security fund and QFII. But the fund company is dominant one on stock invest scale,so it represents typical meaning to research the fund firm. Discussing trade behavior of the fund company with game method, it can analyze game behavior among institution to establish repeated game model on uncertain condition.

articleTitle: Research on Distribute Certification Authentication Construction Based on Multi-secret Sharing in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Most Existing distribute CA constructing is based on (n,k) threshold scheme in mobile ad hoc networks, node's share need update for preventing mobile adversaries from attacks, which brings excessive overhead and need a secure channel to dispense secret share. In this paper, a distribute CA constructing algorithm based on multi-secret sharing is proposed to solve above problems in mobile ad hoc networks. In this scheme, node' share is not updated for preventing mobile adversaries for attacks, furthermore it is unnecessary to maintain a secure channel in the updating period. The analysis results show that the scheme proposed in this paper is simple, feasible and easy to be implemented.

articleTitle: Altruism, Lifetime Uncertainty and Optimal Public Pension Contribution Rate
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Assuming that individuals are altruistic, this paper employs an overlapping generations model with lifetime uncertainty to study the partially funded public pension in China. By comparing the market economy equilibrium with the social optimum allocation, we find the optimal firm contribution rate. Our simulation results show that this rate increases when the life expectancy rises, while decreases when the population growth rate falls. It decreases in the joint case of risen life expectancy and fallen population growth rate because it is much more sensitive to the latter than to the former. The result has some policy implications.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis for the Mechanical Behaviors of Circle-Ended Concrete-Filled Steel Tubular Tower
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A finite element analysis model was established for the circle-ended concrete-filled steel tubular(CFST) tower of a cable-stayed bridge with ldquosharing-noderdquo method of ANSYS, the circle-ended CFST towerpsilas mechanics behaviors in different load cases in the process of the bridgepsilas construction were stimulated by considering variation of the core concretepsilas Poisson Ratio in the constitutive relation. The changing rules of stress in the circle-ended CFST tower which was under axial compression and eccentric compression respectively were summarized, and the most disadvantaged stress state under the tri-axial compression was found out. The modeling method in this paper can simulate the mechanical behaviors of circle-ended CFST tower accurately. The conclusions are significant for the application of the circle-ended CFST tower in projects.

articleTitle: Analysis for Location-Based Key Pre-distribution in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Wireless sensor networks play key roles in many applications. They are often deployed in hostile environment where communications between sensor nodes must be encrypted. This requires the establishment of secure keys between the sensor nodes in the wireless sensor networks. As one of the methods establishing pairwise keys, location-based key pre-distribution scheme takes advantage of the observation that in static wireless sensor network, it is often possible to approximately determine the location of sensor nodes. In this paper, we evaluate the security and connectivity of location-based key pre-distribution scheme when a target field is partitioned using different methods. The analysis in this paper indicates that in the three possible partition methods, the hexagon-based scheme has the highest probability of establishing pairwise keys between sensor nodes, while the triangle-based key scheme can achieve the highest security. The tradeoff between connectivity and security should be taken into consideration in practice.

articleTitle: Fireworks Simulation Based on Particle System
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Fireworks simulation based on particle system is studied in this paper. Fireworks and its particlespsila data structures are established by analyzing the features during setting off fireworks. Related methods about fireworks real-time simulation are designed and implemented. Experiment results show that proposed method is feasible and effective. In addition, experiment results also indicate that the real-time performance is depended on system configuration while simulating fireworks with wake, and better effect can be obtained in current popular configuration when the amount of particles is less than 3000.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization Reliability Design for Cutting Head of Roadheader Base on Incomplete Probability Information
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In view of the road header machine energy consumption and the load fluctuation question, the probabilistic perturbation method and the Edgeworth series technique are employed to devise a practical and effective method for the reliability optimization design for cutting head with non normal distribution parameters on condition that the first four moments of basic random variables are known. The optimized result indicated: load fluctuation and specific energy consumption of cutting head obtains obviously reduces, enhanced mechanical working reliability and energy utilization efficiency of road header.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation on Drought Resistance of Some Ground Covers
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The paper studies the drought resistance and performance of five ground covers (Sedum lineare, Sedum lineare dasiaPu Fupsila, Sedum elatinoides, Zephyranthes candida, Ophiopogon japonicus) under drought-stress through the testing of artificial climatic cabinet. We choose soil moisture content, relative water content of leaves, relative electric conductivity, chlorophyll, SOD, malondialdehyde (MDA), proline (Pro), etc., to be the indexes of adaptability. Based on the related analysis of data, which came from both detection and observation, we carry on the comprehensive evaluation on the five ground covers by using the subordinative function method. The results indicate that their drought resistance in the order from strong to weak is Z. candida > S. elatinoide > S.lineare > S. lineare dasiaPu Fupsila > O. japonicus.

articleTitle: An Object-Based Reconstruction Algorithm of Binary Image
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The object is a set of pixels which includes 1s linked together in the binary image. In this paper, a reconstruction algorithm is presented that is based on the object of the binary image. This algorithm uses the basic relation between the natural pixels of the binary image, and reaches the aim of removing noise the form the noised binary image. Firstly, all connected components of watermark are marked, and then calculating the number of elements for each component. Secondly, the noise elements are generally isolated ones, the connected components having smallest number are all changed, and all elements of which are set to zeros. Thus, some program-cycles maybe run until the difference between the processed watermark and the original one is smaller than assigned threshold value. Experimental results show that this method is effective.

articleTitle: Study on Three-Dimension A.D.HALL Plot for Windward Project: The System Theory is Applied in Windward Project
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The windward project has carried on the system analysis of the A.D.HALL theory in the paper. In this paper, a systemic analysis method for the windward project by using A.D.HALL theory is presented, a three-dimensional A.D.HALL plot. Its engineering system is established. We have conducted the systems engineering research by using construction wind electric field project A.D. hall to the entire wind electric field construction and the management by three dimensional structure figure time peace-keeping logic position. The paper carries on discusses and obtains the systems engineering matrix through A.D hall three dimensional structure figure A11, A12,..., A77 meaning.

articleTitle: Using Grey Theory in CEO Selection
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: To improve the objectivity of evaluating CEO candidatespsila profiles, according to the scores which experts give following from their histories, presents and predicted data sets are presented. A kind of decision-making model based upon grey theory has been established. Using the model would promote the accuracy of the weights which is the output of AHP method, minimize expertspsila preferences, overcome the incomplete and unclear of candidatespsila information, and get an intuitionistic numerical value to help make decision through simple computing. Doing so would help company select the most suitable CEO.

articleTitle: Modeling of Dam-Break for the Tangjiashan Quake Lake
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Quake lake is a familiar aftermath of powerful earthquake, which is often created by landslide. Due to the rains after earthquake and the instability of landslide dam, Quake Lake is usually in risk of dam breaking and threatens people downstream. In this paper, we present a modeling of dam-break for the Tanjiashang Quake Lake formed by Wenchuan Earthquake on May 12 with the DAMBRK Dam-breach model. We simulate the forming and water-flow of dam-breach, and further analyze the overtopping discharge, the burst of the flood and the current downstream face of dam.

articleTitle: Liner CCD for a Single Point of Bridge Vertical Displacement of Non-contact Measurement Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: According to a single point of bridge vertical displacement detectionpsilas characteristics and requirements, I used CCD(Charge Coupled Device) to complete a single point of bridge vertical displacementpsilas remote and non-contact detection, and using Visual C++ as this projectpsilas development environment, complete the user applicationpsilas development. This system have the following advantage, good stability, high performance cost ratio and so on.

articleTitle: Application of a BP Neural Network Based on Principal Component Analysis in ECG Diagnosis of the Right Ventricular Hypertrophy
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper we propose a BP neural network model based on the principal component analysis (PCA) to predicate the Right Ventricular Hypertrophy (RVH), the results show that, the prediction accuracy of the improved model is obviously superior to the pure BP neural model without PCA.

articleTitle: Model and Simulation on Centrifugal Barrel Finishing Based on 3D Discrete Element Method
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The study on enclosed centrifugal barrel finishing has been staying at the experimental period for a long time. The design parameters and process parameters were fully determined by experiences without any theoretical basis. Considering the abrasive particles and workpieces as two kinds of ball particles with different materials and sizes, 3-dimensional discrete element method (DEM) was used to build the dynamics model. Based on such model, by setting different movement parameters, different movement laws and interaction forces of abrasive particles and workpieces were got. We analyzed the behavior of particles filled into a planetary barrel. In this paper, the influence of filling ratio of process parameters on medium movement was mainly analyzed. Then the transient movement diagram and the average contact forces diagram for abrasive particles or workpieces under different filling ratio were obtained. The simulation results are basically coincident to the experimental results. Both results have proved that filling ratio is the main parameter that changes medium motion laws, which provides a very efficient way to further optimize design parameters and process parameters, as well as to improve production efficiency.

articleTitle: Numerical and Experimental Investigation on Bent Plate Dehydration Equipment
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A new method on dehydrating mist in gas with high efficiency is presented. Mist in gas can be dehydrated by the bent plate dehydration. Based on the model of steady flow of incompressible Newtonian fluid, the difference equations of flow and pressure field of bent plate dehydration equipment are built. Numerical Solution of vorticity, stream function and pressure are also obtained. The equations are solved by using matlab Version 6.5. The results show that the pressure loss of bent plate dehydration equipment is mostly affected by its structure parameters and inlet gas velocity. To decrease the pressure loss, length of the bent plate is at 120 mm, turning angle is less than 54deg, and plate spacing is at 20~30 mm. The inlet gas velocity must be less than 6 m/s because the water film on the wall of bent plate will be ruptured when it is more than the critical velocity. It can be seen that the tendency of pressure loss is uniform from the experimental results. The numerical method on solving the pressure loss of bent plate can be used for the industrial design.

articleTitle: The Research of Hybrid Navigation System Positioning Model Combined Microwave and Longwave
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The hybrid navigation system combined Microwave and Longwave is the important trend of development of modern navigation system, but there not exist effective model to position, because of calculatingly complexity of long wave range. The paper designed the model of the hybrid system, according to the theory, and deal with the problems of engineering fact. And it simulated and compared using the designed model and GPS model; it proved the designed model effective. The usage of that model can combine different navigation source, improve and guarantee the reliability and usability of integrated system.

articleTitle: Realization and Performance of Serial Communication between Different Kinds of PLC
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Communication between different kinds of Programmable Logic Controller (PLC), especially the Serial Communication (SC) between S7-300 and FX PLC, was investigated in this paper. The approach of SC between these two kinds of PLC was researched, and the communication performance was tested. On the basis of adequate analysis to the Programmable Port Protocol (PPP) of FX PLC, we designed the SC system structure, which was linking module CP340 of S7-300 to the programmable port of FX PLC with SC-08 programmable cable. And bidirectional semi-duplex SC was realized by configuration and programming to S7-300 PLC. In order to test the communication performance, we proposed a test scheme to measure the communication delay. The reading and writing communication delay were obtained, and the experimental result will be worked as reference when designing the networked control system in this communication structure.

articleTitle: An Algorism of Multi-stage Inventory Control under the Conditions of Demand Obeying MA(1) Model
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper researched multi-stage inventory system under the conditions of MA (1) demand model by combining time series decomposition and dynamic programming to establish DP algorism which can be transformed into optimal multi-stage inventory optimal strategy under the conditions of independent demand.

articleTitle: A Topic Correlation Judgment Algorithm Based on Weight and Threshold
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The topic correlation judgment algorithm based on weight and threshold is proposed as for the problem that web pages which are closely related to the given topic may be neglected due to not all keywords given by the users in the pages when users retrieve the topic they desire on the internet. The algorithm retrieves the topic on the websites in depth by the hierarchical key structure on the basis of the hierarchical topic structure which expands uses’ given keywords into several level keywords and then judges the correlation between the topic and pages according to the comparison between keywords weights and correlation threshold in order to obtain the most desirable pages.

articleTitle: General Real Time Simulation System KDRTS Based on Common Personal Computer Hardware
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Along with the rapidly advancement of the computer hardware and software technology, special-purpose simulation computer system has gradually failed to keep pace with the developing and application trend of simulation technology. So in its development process, simulation computer gradually got rid of the customization road, gradually choose a common path. KDRTS (Ke Da real time simulation system), which has been successfully used in hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) simulation experiment of certain guided weapon system, is a general real simulation system based on common personal computer hardware. This paper introduces composition of the hardware system, structure of the software system and expounds its characteristic of KDRTS in detail.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Optimization of Transmission System of Gears by Means of GA-Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Aimed at minimizing the centre distance of reducer in lift mechanism and being satisfied with the conditions of load-bearing capacity and distribution of transmission ratio, the mathematical model in fuzzy design optimization was set up which was to considering the random character of the value of design parameters. Firstly, the number of teeth of the minor gear in the system, its normal module, and its tooth width were taken as design variables in the condition of definitely selected helical angle, and the sum of volumes of the double circular arc gears was taken as objective function. Then, the design principle of genetic algorithm was employed to build up a mathematic model for optimization of the design of transmission system. Finally, the optimization was performed by using the neural network procedure. The result of optimization showed that, when the genetic algorithm in combination with the neural network procedure was used in the system optimization design, the shortage such as the prematurity phenomenon with the use of the former alone or the local convergence with the latter alone could be overcome.

articleTitle: The Development of Color Quantitative System of Farm Product Based on the Chromaticity Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: According to the chromaticity theory, the computer vision system used in color quantitative measurement was developed, which was marked by the 1980A color luminance meter. Munsell color system is selected to establish the mutual conversion between RGB and L*a*b* color model for camera, the conversion relation between RGB color space of CCD camera and L*a*b* color space under a big color gamut was expressed by the four-layer BP network, the same color card was measured synchronously by the color luminance meter and CCD camera, the color picture captured from CCD camera was expressed for RGB value as the input of neural network, XYZ value was gotten from the color luminance meter, and the L*a*b* value converted from XYZ value was regarded as the real color value of target card, namely the output of neural network. The method combining second general revolving combination design with genetic algorithm was put forward as the optimization for the hidden-layer structure of neural network. Using the data of testing set to test this network and calculating the color difference between forecast value and true value, the result showed than the maximum color difference was 5.6357 NBS, the minimum color difference was 0.5311 NBS, and the average color difference was 3.1744 NBS.

articleTitle: Chaos Analysis and Modeling for Predicting Long-Term Population
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The mathematical model of population growth is based on logistic equation and BP neural network. The total population is predicted for the next 30 years through the use of Logistic modeling and generalization data. The dynamics of population growth is studied in non-linear dynamic, which pointed out that the problem is the issue of chaos. It is difficult to accurately forecast long-term population. Chaotic neural network will be served as a new research way on population control.

articleTitle: An Econometric Model of the Relationship between Foreign Trade and Economic Growth in China
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In order to research the econometric model of the relationship between foreign trade and economic growth in China, it made an empirical study according to the sample with the corresponding data from 1990 to 2007 in China. The results of Granger causality test showed that foreign trade had Granger causality with economic growth. The results of unit root test showed that the time series were stable after 1st difference. The results of cointegration test showed that there was a long-term stable equilibrium relationship between foreign trade and economic growth. If the value of foreign trade increases by 1 percent, the economic will increase by 0.65 percent. With the error correction model, the results showed that the short-term fluctuation of foreign trade would lead to the change of economic growth in the same direction. If economic growth deviates from the long-term equilibrium value, it will be corrected by 14 percent next year.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control System Design of Combine Load Feedback Based on ARM9+µC/OS
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: An intelligent control system of combine load feedback is designed based on ARM9 and μC/OS-II. The input signals ( rotary speed of threshing cylinder, entrainment losses and cleaning losses) are received by the control system and dealt with by the fuzzy neural network and embedded kernel of ARM9. Then it provides the pulse signals of step motor to drive the hydraulic coupler. Finally, the combine can run rapidly and steadily to achieve the dual-high goal of the quality and efficiency. The experimental results prove that the control system has certain stability and can reach anticipated effects.

articleTitle: Study on Output Model and Test of a New Kind of Magnetoelastic Force Sensor
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: To measure the force which act on a mechanical equipment on-line and make the fault diagnosis, a kind of the non-contact force sensor with three magnetic pole based on magnetoelastic effect was designed and its operation principle and the mathematical model of induced voltage output were also derived out in this paper. The output characteristic of the sensor affected by field current intensity, frequency, and the gap between the probe of the sensor and the surface of the material tested was analyzed by testing. The calculation result based on the output model found by the paper accord basically with the test result. The results of the test have showed that the measuring precision and sensitivity of the sensor can meet the demands of the general practical application.

articleTitle: Contrast Analysis of Dynamic Reliability of Random Structure with TMD and MTMD
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The neural network response surface method optimized by genetic optimization algorithm has been proposed to calculate the dynamic reliability of stochastic structure with TMD and MTMD, and a contrast analysis of dynamic reliability between them has been processed. The method has both the advantages of neural network response surface method and the global search of GA, which can approach to optimum solution of the performance function. And the iteration steps of JC method can be reduced effectively. The results of the finite element model show that the proposed method is accurate and effective, and MTMD control is better than TMD control for stochastic structure.

articleTitle: Design of a New Control Sampling Module
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In engineering practice, we need to measure electrical signals accuratly. This paper presents a new approach to realise the AC sampling integrated model efficiently. With AHDL language, the comples AC sampling design schemes both of the software and the hardware are described in the EPLD. Supplied with the A/D conveter, this model can be used as the special AC samling chip to simply the design of AC sampling circuits.

articleTitle: Study on the Construction of Information System for Project Management in Comprehensive Games
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Itpsilas a complicated system engineering to organize the comprehensive games which is a challenge to traditional project management. This paper, based on mature project management software, studies the project management system of comprehensive games, including establishing the purpose, constructing the systematic structural model, designing the process and function and analyzing the expected effect of the system. The author hopes to provide a favorable decision-making tool for the high level executives, improve the organizing and managing skills for comprehensive games and furthermore accelerate the informalization of games management.

articleTitle: Existence of Periodic Solutions of Predator-Prey Diffusive System with Ratio-Dependence and Stage Structure
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper, a non-autonomous predator-prey system with ratio-dependence type functional response and stage structure for predator and time delay in patch circumstances is investigated. By using Gaines and Mawhin's continuation theorem of coincidence degree theory, a set of easily verifiable sufficient conditions to guarantee the existence of positive periodic solutions of the system are obtained. Some new results are obtained.

articleTitle: A Negotiation Model of Supply Chain Based on Multi-agent
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A good negotiation model is important in order to improve the efficiency for supply chain negotiation. A negotiation model of supply chain based on multi-agent is presented. The model framework for supply chain negotiation and the status of the negotiation agents are defined. We also discuss the negotiation strategy and its learning mechanism of negotiation model. According to the characters of supply chain, a negotiation protocol is presented. Simulations prove that the presented negotiation model can improve the efficiency and successful cooperation ratio for supply chain negotiation.

articleTitle: Investigation on FEM Simulation of Bi-based Superconducting Composite Strip Roll Forming Based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A micro-mechanics model of superconducting composite strip has been established. Based on this, in this study, an FEM model of superconducting composite strip was built by ANSYS. And then the forming process and results were simulated and analyzed. The results showed that when the rate of reduction is too large, the strip edge will break, and the cored wire will fracture, super-cored powder wire appears larger lateral cracks, which coincides with the experiment.

articleTitle: Dynamic Simulation on Mechanic-Liquid Coupling Model of Lift Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper researches on the lift mechanism of an engineering car, and uses SimMechanics toolbox and Simulink toolbox to establish a mechanic system simulated model and hydraulic system simulated model; uses subsystem encapsulation technology of Simulink to package the modules; then establishes mechanic-hydraulic coupled model of the lift mechanism and realizes dynamic simulating analysis. It also uses the cooperative mechanism offered by iSIGHT to make DOE analysis and optimization design of the coupled system and obtains satisfying results. The modeling and optimization method used in this paper is meaningful to study other mechanic-hydraulic coupled systems.

articleTitle: Image Restoration Model of PDE Variation
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper study a PDE variational model to image denoising and restoration. The existence and uniqueness of the solution is discussed. A new model of image denoising and restoration is deduced by gradient descent flow method. Then, A new numerical analysis model is obtained. The model can preserve the edge feature and smooth the image. The numerical experiments show that the model delivers better results in image denoising and restoration.

articleTitle: Solving the Steady Flight State of Aircraft Based on Hybrid Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Steady flat flight is widely used in the flight simulator training as an ideal initial state. To ensure the accurate solving of the steady flat flight state a hybrid genetic algorithm is put forward. The algorithm based on the new concept of ldquoindividual learning potentialityrdquo make the Lamarckian learning and Baldwinina learning genetic algorithm combination together organically according to the particularity of the solving in the steady flat flight state. The algorithm could make the advantage of the learning into full play and make the disadvantage into inhibitory. The algorithm has generality which just use the state variable to calculate and can be independent of the airplane dynamic. Simulation result shows that the new algorithm combined the tow learning mechanism has made a good effect.

articleTitle: Implementation of a High Performance Multi-axes Motion-Control Chip
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The system structure and implementation of a self-developed multi-axes motion-control chip with high performance is proposed. The motion-control chip contains a 32-bit NIOSII Reduced Instruction Set Computing (RISC) processor, a programmable 10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet Media Access Control (MAC) interface, 4-channel optic encoder interface, 4-channel pulse generator, digital inputs and outputs, flash and static memory interfaces and LCD interface. Discussions are focused on the kernel modules of mentioned chip system including control pulses generator, quadrature encoder interface, and Ethernet MAC. Simulation results and applications are also presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed motion-control chip which could be widely used for developing high performance stand alone motion controllers and motion control application systems.

articleTitle: Mean-CVaR Portfolio Optimization Problem under Concave Transaction Costs and Minimal Transaction Unit Constraints
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In the paper, considering the fact situation that the transaction number is an integer and associated with portfolio construction is a fee for purchasing assets in the stock market in China at present, we increase minimal transaction unit constraint. And with the concave transaction cost function more conforming to the actual situation, introducing the condition risk value (CVaR) to measure the portfolio risk, we propose a mean-CVaR concave integer programming model under concave transaction costs and minimal transaction unit constraints. In the same time, we give a genetic algorithm to solve this model, and the numerical experiment shows that the model is reasonable and the algorithm is efficient.

articleTitle: A New Method for Direct Deformation of NURBS Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The method to modify the NURBS surface in this paper is not based on the change of the mathematical parameters. It presents a new surface representation for the deformed NURBS surface based on the Cao En model. The deformed surface representation is a combination of two functions: a displacement function and a function for an existing NURBS surface. There is no implied controlling grid structure over the surface. The key points can be placed anywhere in the parameter space. The point displacement constraints directly influence the final shape of the deformed surface. The results show that this method facilitates the designer in a rapid and intuitive manner in editing surfaces.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Portable General Battleplane Simulator for Guided Weapon System Flight Test
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In the background of current realization of the hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) simulation system for guided weapon, this paper develops and expands the function module of battleplane simulator and proposes specific framework of the portable general battleplane simulator. Based on the strengthening industrial personal computer hardware, it carries out general battleplane simulator for portable guided weapon system. The test result proved that the authorpsilas design was right and feasible.

articleTitle: Application of Pattern Recognition and 3D Visual Technology in Shirt Mass Customization
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Under the help of 3D visual technology, the manpsilas shirt was taken as an example for mass customization. According to the Chinese garment criterion, the method of digitizing categorization for garment size designation was explored and developed based on the pattern recognition principle of artificial intelligence. It offered an effective approach to achieve digitizing categorization for garment size designation because of its universal rules for other garment categories.

articleTitle: The Comprehensive Evaluation of Health Care System Based on Entropy Model
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Comprehensive evaluation on health care system of ten countries is discussed in this paper. In order to comprehensively assess and evaluate the health care system in an objective manner, five first-tier indicators and nineteen second-tier indicators are set up as evaluation criteria in the first place. Then entropy modeling and Matlab software are applied to compute the values for first-tier indicators and the evaluation scores for the ten countriespsila health care systems. Three essential indicators to evaluate health care system are selected by Cluster Analysis and SPSS software, and yield same evaluation ranks as the entropy model of five first-tier indicators.

articleTitle: The Effect of Nonstationary in the Precipitation Time Series Predictions
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper, the problem of non-stationary in the precipitation time series predictions is studied. The author used empirical mode decomposition (EMD) and neural network methods to make predictions of the non-stationary time series. The result shows that these methods can improve the prediction accuracy when they were used to predict the precipitation of Beijing, Tianjin, and Shijiazhuang. However the low accuracy was found in the precipitation prediction of Nanjing. The author studied four groups of prediction data with space time-index plot method and showed that prediction error depends on geometrical structure of the attractor in the data.

articleTitle: The Modeling and the Character Emulation of New Type Throttling Grooves on the Electromagnetic Proportion Throttle Valve
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper presents a linear throttling groove, which could make the area of flow section directly proportional to the size of the entrance. When the linear throttling groove is used on the electromagnetic proportion throttle valve, it can achieve the discharge through valve port and the displacement of valve core with a regular linear change, and when the throttle valve is used with proportional electromagnet, which can achieve proportional control between the valve port discharge and the electrical signal easily. Simulating the steady state characteristics of electromagnetic proportion throttle valve with the MATLAB based on its practical working environment, we could get the flow characteristic curve at different valve port sizes, the stiffness characteristic curve and the relation curve between valve port sizes and the flow. Then we analyze the simulation results. The analysis results have an important guiding significance for the design parameters optimization of the electromagnetic proportion throttle valve.

articleTitle: General Strength Models of Constructional Steel and Fracture Analysis of Notched Bars
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Fracture test was performed on 10 notched bars to study fracture mechanism of constructional steel. Test results indicated that plastic deformation concentrated in notch region and crack initiated at center of notched root. Notched bars finally fractured at notched section where stress triaxiality was larger. Fracture mode was combination of shear and normal fracture. According to hydrostatic yield conception of metal, new annotation was given to generalized yield ellipsoidal function of constructional steel. The ellipsoidal fracture function and its parameters were deduced on the assumption that constructional steel yielded and fractured at the same time in tri-axial mean tension stress state. Simulation results of notched bar fracture test showed that fracture took place when the fracture ellipsoidal function reached a critical value.

articleTitle: Study of SNMP Network Management Interface Emulation Method
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: To solve the problem of lack of test environment in development of SNMP network management system, this paper puts forward an integral emulation method of SNMP network management interface. According to emulate the real network, we verify the validity of our method.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of Convective Heat Transfer Steady Thermal Stress in a Ceramic-FGM-Metal Composite ECBC Plate
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In order to study the steady thermal stress and effect factors in a ceramic-FGM-metal composite ECBC plate under convective heat transfer boundary, the finite element analytical model for the composite plate was established. From numerical calculation, when h macr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sub> = hmacr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</sub> =1, T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>=300 K, T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sub>=550 K and T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</sub>=1 800 K, the convective heat transfer steady thermal stress distributions in the plate under ECBC mechanical boundary were obtained and compared with those of the nongraded two-layered ceramic/metal composite plate. The numerical results show that with the increase of the FGM thickness, the stress distribution of the plate is more reasonable. With the increase of M, the change of the stress gradually becomes big in the FGM and ceramic layers. Compared with M =0.2, on the ceramic surface, the stress of M=5 reduces by 6.1%. The thermal stress of ceramic-FGM-metal composite ECBC plate is very gentle and smooth. The results provide the foundations of theoretical calculation for the design and application of the composite plate.

articleTitle: Simulation Model of Gas Migration and Hindering in Underground Tunnel Based on LBM
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A simulation model of gas migration and hindering based on separated multi-component lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) is put forward in order to research gas migration and accumulation on underground tunnel and to prevent major accident in mines. The tunnel is separated into some relative regular blocks through the separated & coupled algorithm and the multi-component LBM is adopted. The gas emission sources are disposed randomly. When gas passing tunnel, the gas emission sources are propagated together with original gas flow. At the same time, the obstacles are set up randomly in tunnels. Using the gas hindering model the changing condition of direction and gas concentration is researched when the gas encountering obstacles, then a powerful tool that can control gas migration and accumulation is provided.

articleTitle: An Extended RBAC Model for the Threshold in Collaborative Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In collaborative environment the threshold structure is common for joint authorization. Although with the powerful ability to enforce security policies, traditional RBAC hardly considers the issue. In order to solve the problem, we describe the threshold permission as a 3-tuple (obj, op, thre), which is distinguished from ordinary permission. Although there are many users who are assigned to the threshold permission, at least thre different users are required to execute jointly the threshold permission. We propose an efficient algorithm to check whether users can execute the threshold permission. We also analyses the influence of userspsila differences impacting on threshold permissions. At last, we discuss how to constraint threshold permissions and associated roles to enforce separation-of-duty which is a fundamental security principle.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis on Financial Income and Development of Economic in China
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Based on the foundation of VAR model. This paper applies impulse response function and variance decomposition to portray the correlations between development of economic and financial income. The result shows that there exists a strong positive response between them in the study period. Economic growth of China has certain positive role in promoting financial income, the existence of long-term stable relationship, but financial income levels to promote economic growth was not obvious.

articleTitle: The Study on Reasonability of Retrospective Power
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: There is an increasingly concern with the use of retrospective power. Some researchers suggested calculating the retrospective power after conducting hypothesis testing, particularly in meta-analysis. They considered that retrospective power can be used to determine whether the sample size is sufficient in an experiment and that the combination of retrospective power and prior power can enhance the power of current and future studies. Furthermore, the commonly used statistical software packages, such as SPSS and SAS, provide retrospective power analysis in some modules. However, some pointed out the abuse of retrospective power. In this study, we used Monte Carlo technique to estimate the retrospective power in t-test and ANOVA to address this issue. We found that four styles of retrospective powers, including observed power, plug-in power, unbiased power and median power, are highly positive correlated. They dispersed distribute in the range of (0.05, 1). The width of 25th-75th percentages achieved 0.38-0.54, the standard deviations 0.25-0.30 for 0.7 of the statistical power. However, they all monotonously decreased in respect to P value. The retrospective powers were negatively correlated with P values with Pearson coefficients ranged from -0.753 to -0.831 (p < 0.001). The nonlinear regression models can be built with R squares all above 0.97. We conclude that retrospective power calculation yield no additional insights if P value is available, and can not be used to estimate the statistical power.

articleTitle: The Design and Development of a Flight Control System for a Small Size Unmanned Helicopter
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Small size unmanned helicopter has found diverse applications for both civil and military missions. In order to develop a flight robot based on a small size unmanned remotely controlled helicopter, a flight control system is presented in this paper. The hardware and software of the system are designed. The design goal is to have the helicopter achieve stable hover. As the kernel of the system, the flight control strategies are described which based on artificial neural network and human operator's skill. The processed flight data are used to train and validate a multilayer artificial neural network offline, and then the trained artificial neural network is reconstructed in the flight control system for control strategies.

articleTitle: Study of Carrying Capacity of Water Resources Which Based on System Dynamics Model in Aibi Lake Area of Xinjiang
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper uses system dynamics model predicting that water resources could meet the basic use of all professions and trades in Bole city, Jinghe county, wenquan county in the future 30 years which is as 2000 as the base year. However, it has been concerned that Aibi lake which maintain its perennial water 7.12 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> has not shrunk, the entire region will be water shortage over the next 30 years, it is expected that all professions and trades will be cumulatively water shortage about 9.26 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> in this region.

articleTitle: Orthonormal Ladder Structure Log-Domain Filter
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A novel method for the design of log-domain filters is presented which is based on the operational simulation of orthonormal ladder networks. The approach permits the realization of a given arbitrary filter transfer functions. By using the method, a third-order log-domain elliptic lowpass filter with 1 dB ripples is designed. PSPICE simulations show the proposed filter possesses almost ideal frequency responses, simple circuit topology, low sensitivity and optimum dynamic range, etc.

articleTitle: The Maximum Entropy Method for Constrained Nonlinear lp Problems
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper, using the maximum entropy function and penalty function, we propose the maximum entropy method to solve the constrained nonlinear lp problems. We give the convergence result of our algorithm and the numerical result show the possibility and efficiency of our algorithm.

articleTitle: Quantitative Prediction of Synthetic Food Colors by Fluorescence Spectroscopy and Radial Basis Function Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper, quantitative prediction of synthetic food colors by fluorescence spectroscopy and radial basis function neural networks is introduced. Taking Amaranth as an example, for sample solution of Amaranth with different concentrations, the fluorescence spectroscopy excited by the light with the wavelength of 400 nm is measured. The peak wavelength of Amaranth solution fluorescence spectroscopy is about 640 nm, and a non-linear relationship is observed between fluorescence relative intensity and concentration of solution. For each sample, 10 emission wavelength values were selected. The fluorescence intensity corresponding to the selected wavelength was used as the network characteristic parameters, a radial basis function neural network was trained and constructed. The trained radial basis function neural network was employed to predict the three kinds of samples Amaranth solution concentration .The relative error of prediction were 4.60%, 4.71%, 5.94%. The results show that the method is convenient, fast, of high accuracy. It is a new technique for the detection of synthetic food color in food safety supervision and management.

articleTitle: A Steganalytic Algorithm Aiming at JPEG Image
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This algorithm is specially aimed at steganalytic algorithm of JPEG image and used to detect whether hidden information exists in it. According to the structural feature of JPEG image and through analyzing the DCT coefficient, the algorithm firstly extract quantification matrix, and judge whether hidden information exists in the image according to the relationship between image and the quantification matrix. This algorithm introduces an improved method of extracting quantification matrix, and raises the efficiency and accuracy of extracting quantification matrix, which makes the algorithm acquire a comparatively high accuracy rate of detecting.

articleTitle: Value of 64-Row Computed Tomography Angiography in Detecting Coronary Artery Anomalies in Young Asymptomatic Men
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The commonest cause of sudden cardiac death is anomalous origin of coronary arteries (AOCA). Conventional coronary angiography is the gold standard for the diagnosis of AOCA. However, this technique is limited by its invasive. Multi-detector computed tomography electrocardiogram is increasingly important tool in the identification and assessment of cardiac-related disease processes, including those associated with sudden cardiac death. We found 64-row multi-detector computed tomography is a feasible, noninvasive screening tool of detecting AOCA.

articleTitle: Study on Lyapunov Exponential Spectrum Calculation Method of Nonlinear Characteristics of a Class of an Impact Damper
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The global parameters-varying rules of the Lyapunov exponential spectrum on this system are analyzed by numerical simulations in this paper. The calculation method of Lyapunov exponential spectrum on a class of an impact damper vibration system is discussed by theoretical analysis and numerical calculation. Comparing the Lyapunov exponential spectrum diagram with the global bifurcation diagram, the validity and feasibility of this method of analyzing system stability using the Lyapunov exponential spectrum diagram is verified. Some nonlinear characteristics under relevant parameters of the impact damper are also given in the paper.

articleTitle: Research on 3-D Computer Aided Design of Rapid Manufacture for the Movement System in Diesel Engine Based on PRO/E
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: To carry out 3-D (three dimensions) design for the movement system in diesel engine, the top-down method is used. The general model is created in assembly and every part design is finished according to general assembly. The group of piston crankshaft connecting rod is designed and each part is modeled in Pro/E. Pro/E is a solid modeler and this offers considerable advantage for solid model creation. Normally, the geometry is first sketched in 2-D and then extruded in the third direction to generate a 3-D model. This base geometry can be created using either the EXTRUDE or the REVOLVE options. Once this base geometry has been created, additional features like holes, rounds, chamfers, fillets, ribs, etc can be added in the finishing stages of the part creation. The center of the bowl does not coincide with the center of the cylinder due to the presence of valve pockets. The obvious advantage of this configuration is that is gives the true geometry of the piston and the presence of connecting rod means that the connecting rod ports can be accommodated when the piston is at the top dead center. Various instances of this configuration will then be created using the ldquoFamily Tablerdquo option of Pro/E wildfire in an attempt to optimize the engine performance. The presence of the connecting rod will make the mesh creation process more challenging for the modeler. This means that the numerical computation will be more intensive.

articleTitle: A New Method of Blind Beamforming Using Phase Correlation of Direction Vector
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A new method of blind beamforming with phase correlation of direction vector is proposed in this paper. Firstly, higher-order cumulant blind beamforming is expatiated. Then, a new method is put forward which integrates cumulant-based algorithm with phase correlation of direction vector. By dealing with underwater experimental data, the new method is proved valid and effective.

articleTitle: Calculation of Mooring Tension of the Ship-Based Helicopter Based on FEM
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The forces of the ship-based helicopter are analyzed comprehensively in the winds and waves. The parameterized FEM model about the ship-based helicopter body, the mooring cable and the mooring base is established with the language APDL. The parameterized FEM model is used to calculate the tension of the mooring cables for different sea conditions. The mooring cable will present strong nonlinearity under the action of external force. So the cable structure is disposed by the finite element method. The warp of parking position and change of sea conditions are taken into account for calculation. After defining the constraint conditions and applying external loads, the mooring tension is obtained. Compared with the theoretical and actual value, the result of the mooring tension is verified reliable. The new calculation method is supplied to improve the force state of the mooring facility.

articleTitle: The Research on Risk Evaluation for Technological Innovation Base on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: To the risks of technological innovation, risk evaluation index system is set up, and the comprehensive evaluation model is introduced in this paper. The weight of each risk factor influencing technological innovation in the model has been objectively calculated by using improved genetic algorithm . A practical example shows that this method can obtain the optimum scheme and provide the scientific decision basis for investor and administrator of technological innovation.

articleTitle: Research on Individual Soldier Automatic Weapon Design Based on MDO
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: It is necessary to employ the Multidisciplinary Design Optimization (MDO) method in the design process of automatic weapon, because the process in itself is related to many disciplines and their couplings. The knowledge structure of MDO is analyzed, which includes mathematic modeling, system decomposition, optimization framework, approximation model, sensitivity analysis, optimization method, software integration, and etc.. The idea of using MDO in the design process of individual soldier automatic weapon is also explored. Based on the software package of iSIGHT, the primary multidisciplinary integration is carried out. Current research work will be helpful for further research on integrating MDO into the design of automatic weapon.

articleTitle: An Advanced Semiconductor Optical Device's Simulator Implemented by Object-Oriented Programming
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive semiconductor optical device (SOD) simulation tool produced by object-oriented programming (OOP). First, the SOD is assumed to be composed of the elementary cell which is abstracted from semiconductor optical amplifiers. Meanwhile, some auxiliary classes and inheritance hierarchies are defined. Besides, the numerical and transaction algorithms with high performance are developed. Thus, the OOP model with high efficiency has been established to analyze the static and dynamic device behaviors. The practice shows that the simulator which can be easily maintained is flexible and extensible.

articleTitle: Study on Landmark Event in Process Control of Large-Scale Project
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The landmark plan play an important role in scheduling management for large-scale project. In this paper the concept of landmark event completion date of fuzzy proposed, and realize the completion date of fuzzy based on the fuzzy network technology; the Markov trait of landmark event is discussed, give the calculation method of one step transition probability according to the calculation of fuzzy Markov chain transition probability, establish the project process prediction model of Markov computer simulation; the forecasts of the project process are realized in using of the language of MATLAB, a new method of macroscopically process control for larger scale project was provided for owner.

articleTitle: Content-Adaptive Interpolation for Spatial Error Concealment
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
