abstract: When transmitting encoded images over a communication channel, the reconstructed image quality can be substantially degraded by channel errors. This paper presents a spatial error concealment algorithm that utilizes variance of surrounding pixels, and then classifies each error block (EB) into two categories: uniform block and edge block. For uniform block, nearest border prior spatial interpolation is adopted to restore missing pixels. We use the Wiener interpolation algorithm and special interpolation sequence for edge block. Experimental results indicate the proposed algorithm can attain well restored quality of intra-frames both subjectively and objectively. Meanwhile, the computational cost of the proposed algorithm can be significantly reduced, compared to Lipsilas method. And the restored quality is almost the same, sometimes even much better.

articleTitle: Fatigue Reliability Evaluation of Casting Bolster of Heavy Haul Freight Car
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A three-dimensional model of bolster of heavy haul freight train was set up in the ANSYS11.0 according to the Codes of AAR M-202-05, the stress distribution of the casting bolster was calculated and analyzed. The result shows that the fatigue strength of the bolster was adequate and the relative weak point was found out. On the basis, the actual measurement test of entire car when it was running on the rail track was performed and the stress history of the key position of the bolster was obtained. Further, the stress spectrum was worked out with rain-flow counting method. Finally, by means of the revised Minerpsilas damage rule and K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub>-S-N curve of casting, the fatigue life of the bolster was predicted.

articleTitle: Technology in Computer Aided Architectural Design
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Technology development of CAAD has changed the mode of architectural design. Through the overview of the various computer technologies of 3D modeling, BIM, IFC and CAAD network applied in architectural design, this paper discusses the additive relationship of these technologies and the conclusion is given that the 3D virtual model is the key of CAAD and the base of BIM, as IFC of BIM is the prerequisite of the CAAD network and the future development in CAAD will follow this correlate sequence.

articleTitle: The Design of Equipment Support Manage System Based on Business Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The problem of data procession in a majority of units isn't the lake of data at present. The problem is large numbers of data redundancy and data disaccord. Data congesting comes forth in the units because of the contradiction between enormous data quantity and traditional data management plan. Therefore, equipment management system based on BI is brought forward in this article. Multi-view metadata management technology, data preprocessing technology, data mining technology, and individuation data exhibit technology is used to develop equipment support decision support system. The system includes equipment support distributing data mining, equipment management data multi-dimensional analysis and evaluation.

articleTitle: Stability of a Model of Nonlinear Forest Insect Pests
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Based on the classical epidemic mode, a new epidemic model of forest which integrates Monochamus Alternatus Hope with Pines was established. The expression of the critical threshold was found. It is proved that, when the critical threshold less than 1, the disease free equilibrium is locally asymptotically stable, and when the critical threshold more than 1, the insect pests equilibrium is locally asymptotically stable. In addition to, the limit cycle of this model is non existent.

articleTitle: Inspection and Orientation Model of Digital Camera
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: According to the collection and pretreatment of the graphics information, algorithm of Canny is used to determine the pixel coordinates of the all centers, the target picture coordinates and the relative positions of the two cameras. So the positioning model of the digital camera is built. The precision and stability of the model are tested by using the average relative precision and the overall conservation degree. The results indicate that the average precision and the overall conservation degree of the model maintain a higher degree.

articleTitle: System Model for the Large Sale Petrochemical Complex
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The article take the computer as the auxiliary means, the use linear plan theory to the large-scale petroleum chemical industry combination unit system establishment mathematical simulation model, simulates the entire wrap petroleum chemical industry installment the investment, delivers, describes between each response mathematical logic relations and the inner link, and causes the model reflection production craft characteristic as far as possible, simultaneously produces optimized algorithm solution actual problem and so on planned production, cost accounting.

articleTitle: Study on Simulation of Gymnastics Movement and the Arrangement Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The technology of virtual reality is one of the most important simulation technologies in the world today for its effect and low outlay. A feasible method of the gymnastics movement and the arrangement in the environment of virtual reality is presented in the paper. The model of the gymnastics movement and the arrangement in a set is built by 3Dmax. A system for the movement and movement combination of gymnastics in a set is exploited by the computer virtual reality technique. This newly exploited system can visualize the movement combination process of gymnastics and make it editable. It can decrease the dangerous of the created difficult movement and extend the coachpsilas arrangement space. Also, it makes a good preparation for further research of simulation of gymnastics movement.

articleTitle: The Plastic Limit Stability Analogy between Centrifugal Concreted-Filled Steel Tubes and Cylindrical Shells with Spiral Stiffeners under Torsion
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The plastic buckling calculation of the centrifugal concreted-filled steel tubes under torsion was derived from the cylindrical shells with spiral stiffeners analogy. In applying the analogy, it is assumed that under torsion, concrete compression parts between the diagonal cracks work as spiral stiffeners of steel shells, based on the plastic performance and mechanism of the tubes under experiment. An analytical method was proposed for the torsional plastic stability of the cylindrical shells with spiral stiffeners. The method was applied to the tubes of varied slenderness ratios (3, 5, 10, 12, 15) and varied steel ratios (0.12, 0.17, 0.236), and the results indicate that the torsion resistant plastic stability of the tube increases by 6% when the steel ratio is 0.12 or 0.17, and the slenderness ratio varies between 5 and 15; and that the torsion resistant plastic stability of the tube can increases by 20% reaching its top, when the steel ratio reaches 0.236.

articleTitle: An Extended Ambient Calculus Model Oriented Mobile Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The ambient calculus can depict the essence of mobile computing mobility on the basic level, but it canpsilat depict the collaboration character of collaboration computing. In order to depict the collaboration character of mobile collaboration while depicting mobility of it, a novel model named EACM, an extended ambient calculus model oriented mobile collaboration, was provided based on ambient calculus. Firstly, Act was extracted as the basic unit of collaboration through analysis the services and tasks in mobile collaboration. Then, Act was mapped to the process of ambient calculus to become the basic entity of calculus. Further, the primitives of mobile and communications in mobile collaboration were constructed. Subsequently, the definitions of basic operation relations were given by mobile and communication primitives. Finally, the instance was given to validated the semantic correctness of EACM. The result indicates EACM has correctly semantic and can effectively depict the mobility and collaboration character of mobile collaboration. And it provides a strong theoretic support to build the platform supporting mobile collaborative services.

articleTitle: Analysis and Numerical Simulation of a Predator-Prey Model with Beddington-DeAngelis Function Response and Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper, a predator-prey model with Beddington-DeAngelis function response and diffusion is studied. Uniform persistence of the system is discussed . The sufficient condition of local asymptotic stability and global asymptotic stability of the positive equilibrium is showed . Then , stability of the system is Simulated by Matlab.

articleTitle: Construction Safety Monitoring and Finite Element Analysis on the Supporting System of Tower Crane in Guangzhou West-Tower
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The West-Tower in Zhujiang New Town of Guangzhou covers an area of 451,926 square meters. The main turret has about 103 stories and 432 meters high, it will become the highest building and a new landmark building in Guangzhou upon to now. Guangzhou West-Tower is also one of the highest constructing complicated structures in China. Considered the complexity of this structure, to secure the safety of the construction stage, the structure was monitored during construction stage by Guangdong provincial academy of building research. This paper presents part results of the construction phase monitoring of Guangzhou West-Tower. Combined with the National Key Technology R&D Program in the 11th Five year Plan of China, the finite element model of the supporting system of tower crane is established to calculate the stress and deformation of bars under the conditions of four different loading states, which are compared with the on-site collected data to ensure that the main structure carried out safely and smoothly.

articleTitle: A Texture Synthesis Algorithm Based on Block Matching
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Texture synthesis has been one of the research focuses in computer graphics, computer vision and image processing fields, and it has applied in image repair, texture replacement, cartoon fracture, image coding, and error concealment. This paper introduces the study of the synthesis methods based on image blocks, presents the causal neighbor field synthesis method on based image blocks which are all under Markov random field (MRF) model hypothesis. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Iterative Decoding Structure Design of LPCA-Turbo
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: An improved decoding structure of LPCA-Turbo (Linear Prediction Control Algorithm, Turbo code) is presented in this paper. A linear module established by the values of the former exterior information of the component decoder could be equivalent to the SISO module. By the linear module the value of No(n+1) exterior information could be predicted. The computation quantity and time of the LPCA will be smaller than the traditional decoding algorithm. Therefore, the complexity and delay of the decoding algorithm can be reduced by the new decoding scheme presented in this paper. What is shown in the simulation result is that while the error-rate performance of the new decoding structure based on LPCA is only lower by 0.1-0.2dB than the traditional Turbo decoding structure, a decoding iterative process of the component decoder could be reduced in the LPCA-Turbo.

articleTitle: Dynamic Knowledge Increase of Associative Memory for Many to Many Based on Incidence of Patterns
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Dynamic knowledge increase of associative memory is essential for practical applications of artificial neural networks. However existing discrete bipolar neural networks have no properties to achieve this aim. In this paper, we proposed an new multi module associative memory model for many to many associations based on incidence of patterns, through adding new neurons and connections to neural networks of this model, which may increase knowledge dynamically as well as not forget information stored before. The properties of dynamic knowledge increase in new associative memory are investigated in detail.

articleTitle: Study on Numerical Simulation of Single-Phase Injection Device Flow Flied
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The injection device is widely used in various industrial fields. The liquid-liquid single-phase flow flied of injection device was simulated with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) software FLUENT based on standard K-epsiv two-equation turbulent mode. The results showed that: the fluid movement disorder at the entrance of mixing chamber and is even more confusion when into the interior with the phenomenon of vortex separation and fluid corner separation.

articleTitle: The Research and Design for Web Print Component Based on EJB Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: With the increasing application based on Web, the comparatively backward Web printing technology lead so much inconvenience to the development of Web system and slowed the pace of Web application in enterprises. In this work, by making use of component programming ideas and EJB technology, a Web print components was developed which based on the analysis of PDF format. Thus, it provides a simple and practical Web printing solution based on this print component. The schema especially meets the requirements of the print with fixed format and changing content.

articleTitle: Digital Electro-hydraulic Proportional Control for Bulldozer Working Device
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: It mainly introduces that proportional decompression valve which substitutes for original PPC valve is used as priority valve to make up of digital electro-hydraulic proportional directional valve with multiple unit valve, which fulfills digitized electro-hydraulic proportional control for bulldozer working device. First apply Simulink in the software MATLAB to simulate the dynamic characteristic of proportional decompression valve, and then simulate the whole system. At length, it proves that the mathematic model of each part is right through experiments.

articleTitle: Electricity Sales Price Model Considering the Purchasing Power of Users and Their Regional Differences
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In the initial stage of electric power marketization, the power supply enterprises are expected to participate in the market competition and engage in the public services as well. Meanwhile, the electricity sales price should be set by considering the interests of enterprises, users and all aspects of the society. Based on welfare economics theory, to take region as a unit and select the economic location entropy as the quantitative evaluation indicator of userspsila purchasing power, which should be introduced to the price elasticity of power demand to establish the electricity sales price model considering the purchasing power of users and their regional differences. Example analysis shows that, while maximizing the profits of power supply enterprises, the model is equipped with scientificity and rationality by enhancing the utility of users as well as the level of social welfare.

articleTitle: Virtual Colonoscopy by Computer-Assisted Three-Dimensional Reconstruction in Screening and Surveillance of Colorectal Polyps
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: OBJECTIVE To evaluate the diagnostic value of virtual colonoscopy using computed tomographic colonography (CTC) in screening and surveillance of colorectal polyps. METHODS: 756 patients underwent CTC and follow-up conventional colonoscopy in two teaching hospitals. Radiologists interpreted the CTC images using computer 3D technique. The outcome measures were the sensitivity and specificity of CTC for the identification of polyps seen at colonoscopy. RESULTS: CTC detected 204 polyps in 189 of the 212 patients and conventional colonoscopy detected 244 colorectal polyps more than 5 mm in diameter in 207 of the 212 patients. For polyps detection, the overall sensitivity of CTC was 85% (95% CI, 81%-93%) but this increased to 95% (95% CI, 88%-99%) for polyps more than 10 mm in size. CTC and colonoscopy screening strategies resulted in similar detection rates for advanced neoplasia. CONCLUSION: Computer-assisted detection applied to CTC is a sensitive screening and surveillance tool for the screening of colorectal polyps.

articleTitle: Monitoring Winter Wheat Phenology Using Time Series of Remote Sensing Data
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The phenological dynamics of crops reflect the dynamics of the Earthpsilas agroecosystems. Crop phenology extraction of from time series of remote sensing data is a promising avenue to study the dynamics of crop development. In this paper, a three step procedure for detecting onset of winter wheat greenness from time series of remote sensing data is presented. A new phenology model models the whole wheat growth cycle as a Gaussian curve. Using this procedure, greenup onset dates of wheat are extracted from time series of VEGETATION and AVHRR data. The extracted onsets for the study site show good agreement with in situ phenology observation. Interanual variability of wheat phenology is identified and analyzed with climate dataset. This study demonstrates the utility of remote sensing data as a tool for detecting temporal variability of winter wheat phenology.

articleTitle: The Empirical Analysis about the Relationship between the Financial Openness and Commercial Bank Risk in China
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this article, first of all, we have measured the degree of China's financial openness and commercial bank risk, and on the basis of data, we have analyzed the relationship between financial openness and commercial bank risk from the model of unit root test, co-integration test, error correction model, Granger causality test and impulse response function. We find there exists co-integration relationship between the Bank Risk (lnBR) and the Financial Openness (lnFO). Through Granger causality test, it proves financial openness is cause, bank risk is result, and financial openness will lead to the increase of bank risk. And from impulse response function, we find there is a time lag in increasing bank risk that was brought about by increasing the degree of financial openness.

articleTitle: Study on Linear Move Irrigation Synchronization Control System in Virtual Scene
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Linear move irrigation system is widely used for its water saving and high automatization character, but the traditional go-stop-go driving method made the linear move irrigator hard to control and hard to get good irrigation efforts. Thus new control way with high efficiency in operation and low consuming of water, electricity, other materials and human resource is needed to develop to avoid this problem. Because of the difficulty of examination, virtual reality technology is used to simulate the controlling and driving system in this thesis. Build three-dimension models of the irrigation system departments according to their scale with Pro/ENGINEER, and three-dimensional scenes of farmland with Multigen Creator software. Assemble the departments together to six towers with Multigen Creator and analysis the forces of the mechanical models of the irrigation system according to the principles of ground vehicle dynamics. Visual C + + 6.0 and Multigen Vega were used to program an application, which load the three-dimension models of the irrigation system into the scenes of farmland. Then simulate the control system and drive system to study the moving properties of towers when the alignment angle between two adjacent towers changes. The simulation results show that the system can reflect the large-scale irrigation factually, and can optimize control parameters through simulation.

articleTitle: On Inner-Product Algorithm in Calculating Normal-Forms and Realization with Computer Algebra
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Calculating normal-forms is one of the main algorithms on studying nonlinear dynamical system. There are matrix-expressing, conjugate-operator and Lie-algebra algorithms which can be used in the calculation. It is well known that calculating with conjugate-operator is the main step in finding all orders of normal forms. In this paper, a Mathematica package is presented for calculating normal-forms with inner-product algorithm. The package we compiled possesses generality in calculating high order normal-forms of nonlinear dynamical systems.

articleTitle: Random Analysis on Line-Heat Source Temperature Field of Ground Source Heat Pumps Buried Pipes
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper the random properties of ground-source heat pump (GSHP) system. GSHP buried pipe to Kelvin one-dimensional line source of heat transfer model are discussed. The model randomness is analyzed, and the GSHP buried pipe to random excess temperature field, space-time statistics and the correlation of features are studied. The calculation results show that, heat transfer in buried pipe obviously have relationship with the distance from the pipe center and run time of system, and also the heat transfer between buried pipes can not be ignored. The method in this paper has great significance for improving the reliability design theory and reducing the construction cost of GSHP buried pipe.

articleTitle: The Error Estimates of Predicted Value of Variational Assimilation Method for a Class of Schrödinger Equations
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Variational assimilation method (VAM) is discussed for a class of Schrodinger equations. For global and local observational data, initial value inverse problem is discussed with VAM and the error estimates of predicted value for VAM for a class of Schrodinger equations are made. The validity of the VAM in complex plane is illustrated in the paper.

articleTitle: A Stable Congestion Control Mechanism in Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Ad hoc network is network in which there is no base station and any node can be connected to network temporarily. To support mobility, Node in ad hoc network generally communicates by wireless channel. In Ad hoc network, TCP Reno or TCP Vegas do not work well as they do in wire network, because they take packet losses or timeout as the signal of congestion. However, in ad hoc network, temporary link outages or fading-induced bit errors will result in packet losses, so TCP will decrease cwnd improperly. Some variations of TCP have been developed to improve the transport protocol performance for wire network. These approaches progress along two directions: one direction is to hide any losses not related to congestion from the sender, so that the sender can only detect the packet losses due to congestion, such as I-TCP or snoopy protocol. However these protocols are not fit for Ad hoc network in which there are not middle base stations between wire link and wireless link. Thus, the other direction, explicit congestion notification (ECN), is a promising direction in wireless network. In the paper, we propose a new stable congestion based on expanded ECN mechanism to respond packet losses in wireless environment more properly. The paper gives the idea to construct the new mechanism, and analyses the stability of the new mechanism. By using NS-2 simulator, the paper compares the new mechanism on throughput, drop ratio and delay time with TCP Reno and TCP Vegas. The simulation result indicates the renovation mechanism can get better tradeoff of throughput and delay time, so it can work well in Ad hoc network.

articleTitle: Time Delay Estimation Algorithm of Closed Loop System Using Mathcad Package
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper deals with the closed loop system called Adaptive Time Delay Estimation (ATDE) for estimating time delay between two signals is presented. The simulation of this algorithm accomplished by using MathCAD package are carried out. The technique that we will present this work is based on the error between two samples of the incoming signal the difference between the delayed signal and the reference signal passed through a known delay as performance index for the estimator. The algorithm adaptively controls the delay, so as to minimize the mean square of this error. Derivation of the algorithm is presented as well as several tests of different cases are carried out.

articleTitle: Error Simulation Analysis of Gripping Deviation of Plate Specimen Tensile Test Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The plate specimen tensile test is a common material mechanical property test in practical engineering, but the gripping deviation of plate specimen will bring tensile test result an error. In this paper, a finite element model of aluminum alloy notched specimen is built and a static finite element analysis is carried on, the influence of the plate specimen tensile test gripping position deviation rightness of experiment to the test result is studied. The result expresses that the gripping deviation of plate specimen will bring tensile test result an error bigger. It is necessary to raise the accuracy request of the gripping position of plate specimen tensile test.

articleTitle: Optimization Algorithm Based on Artificial Life Algorithm and Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: An optimization algorithm based on artificial life algorithm and particle swarm optimization (PSO) is proposed. The optimization includes two stages. In the first stage, artificial life system is created. As artificial life organisms have a sensing system, they can find the resource they want and metabolize it. The micro-interaction with each other in the artificial life's group results in emergent colonization in the whole system. The emergent colonization of artificial life system is used to provide an excellent initial position for PSO, and PSO is further used to find the optimal solution in the second stage. Compared with ordinary artificial life based optimization approach and ordinary PSO approach by simulation, in the newly designed method, the performances of searching speed and optimization solution accuracy are improved.

articleTitle: Application of ANSYS Analysis in Electromagnetic Drive Liquid Flow
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: By analyzing the dynamic flow driven by electrolyte solution in the magnetic field and electric field that respectively generated by solenoid and parallel plate electrodes, this article did the electromagnetic field calculation and flow field calculation via ANSYS software, and the results for magnetic analysis, electric field and magnetic field coupling analysis, fluid driven analysis and fluid circumfluent analysis were obtained thereby.

articleTitle: Approximate Solutions of a Hypersingular Boundary Integral Equation
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In the paper, a reproducing kernel method of solving hypersingular integral equations (HSIE) with cosecant kernel is proposed. Difficulties lie in its singular term of solving HSIE. In order to remove singular term, hypersingular term with square cosecant kernel is transformed into singular term with Hilbert kernel. Subsequently, by making a equivalent transformation singular term with Hilbert kernel is removed. It's advantages the series representation of solution is obtained in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space. On the other hand, the representation of reproducing kernel becomes simple by improving the definition of traditional inner product and requirements for image space of operators are weakened comparing with traditional reproducing kernel method. The final numerical experiments illustrate the method is efficient.

articleTitle: Simulation and Dynamic Analysis of Cool Storage Tank for Air-Conditioning
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Mathematical model of melting problem of phase change material (PCM) in cool storage tank was established. Moreover, the effective heat capacity method was used to simulate the heat transfer processes of cool storage tank, the changing relation curves of melting ratio, temperature and the diameter of cool storage tank along with time were obtained. The results show that the time of the ambulatory melting is shorter than the fixed melting by 7.65%, the difference between solid and liquid densities have a relatively great influence on the thermal performance of discharging processes of cool storage systems. In addition, it was valuable in improving design and reducing the loss of cool storage system.

Author Keywords: difference between solid and liquid densities

articleTitle: An Intrusion Detection Technology Based on Immune Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Using the specific immunity and clonal expansion principles of B , T cells of human immune system in intrusion detection is a significative research. We proposed a new kind of structure of detection, which is using vulnerability and its corresponding data, and setting up tree code mode. Employing the improved CLOPE cluster's algorithm at antibody muster to distill the fragment of variable region, and then rearrange the gene. It can integrate the antibody muster, detect unknown attack. Experiments show that the method can not only detect defined intrusion fast and accurate, but also undefined intrusion, especially anamorphosis of defined attack.

articleTitle: A Evaluation Model of Web-Based Distance Education for the Deaf Undergraduate
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Constructing an effective evaluation model is an important mission for distance education workers. Based on the features and requirements of Web-education, this paper designs a teaching evaluation model for the deaf on Web-based distance education. This paper is aimed to introduce the model, and introduces it on the aspects of Web-teachingpsila features and evaluation process.

articleTitle: Predictive Model of Pipeline Damage Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Because the damage of pipeline is controlled by many factors, such as fault movement, pipe-soil interaction, buried depth, etc., the relationship between pipeline damage and influencing factors is complicated. In order to predict the pipeline damage, predictive model is constructed on the basis of artificial neural network (ANN), in which the damage of pipeline becomes a nonlinear function of influence factors. According to eight groups sample data, MATLAB is applied to analyze the design of predictive model; influences of model structure, concealed layer number, neuron number of concealed layer, and training function, on the predictive results are analyzed. Model parameters and preferences are optimized, and predictive model of pipeline damage is determined based on results of numerical simulation. Finally, optimum model structure is worked out and some advice for modeling and protection of pipeline is proposed.

articleTitle: Well Posedness of Generalized Mutually Minimization Problem
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Let C be a closed bounded convex subset of a Banach space X with 0 being an interior point of C and p<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sub>(.) be the Minkowski functional with respect to C. Let B(X) be the family of nonempty bounded closed subset of X endowed with the Hausdorff distance. A generalized mutually minimization problem min<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sub>(F,G) is said to be well posed if it has a unique solution (x. z) and every minimizing sequence converges strongly to (x. z). Under the assumption that C is both strictly convex and Kadec, G is a nonempty closed, relatively boundedly weakly compact subset of X, using the concept of the admissible family M of B(X) , we prove the generic result that the set E of all subsets F such that the generalized mutually minimization problem minC(F,G) is well posed is a dense subset of M. These extend and sharpen some recent results due to De Blasi, Myjak and Papini, Li, Li and Xu, and Ni, etc.

articleTitle: Research on Nonlinear Vibration of Gear Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This thesis focuses on the cylindrical spur-gear transmission system in accessory drive casing of aero-engine. By using Lumped-mass Method, a coupling vibrant model that includes time-varying meshing stiffness, transmission errors and backlashes et al is established. Employing Runge-Kutta integration method, the governed nonlinear dynamic equations are solved. The steady state responses show the strong-nonlinear behavior of the transmission system. Based on time history, phase plane plot and Ponicare map, the steady state responses are analyzed. Influence of the internal excitation is discussed in this paper. As internal excitation increases, the motion states experience a process from periodic motion to quasi-periodic motion, and then to periodic motion again.

articleTitle: Visualization Modeling of Mine Roadway Based on DirectX
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Digital Mining (DM) is the information model, 3D visualization modeling of roadway is an application of DM and occupies a very important position in DM's construction. In 3D visualization raodway , people can get its 3D graphic and know the engineering change accurately in time, and it's helpful for showing the spatial relationships of excavation engineering and orebody, wall rock even the surface diggings. Take Dongtan mine of Shandong as example, this paper mainly researche the data processing - arithmetic, modeling method and visualization analyses of roadway based on DirectX 9.0C. That is builds every regular roadway according to the key points of it to realize 3D roadway modeling through the process of point→line→face→single roadway→multi-roadway. Finally through combined with the technology of texture mapping and light setting, the author modeling the roadway and do some spatial analyses also.

articleTitle: Safety Evaluation of Penstock Laid on Downstream Surface of Dam and Its Expansion Pipe
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Finite element method and analytic method are used to safety evaluation of a penstock laid on downstream surface of dam and its expansion pipe on the following issues: (i) Concrete cracking zone, maximum crack width and stress in liner and bars are calculated and analyzed with allowable value; (ii) Relative displacement at both sides of the joint between dam and power station, and stress of expansion pipe are calculated and analyzed with allowable value. The conclusion show that the scheme of penstock layout design and structural design is reasonable for steel playing high strength role, that the penstock structure has safe bearing capacity, and that the expansion pipe scheme can meet the design requirements of compatible structure displacement and requirements of strength.

Author Keywords: penstock laid on downstream surface of dam

articleTitle: Application Research on Image Processing in Vehicle Course Angle Detecting System
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Course deviation of vehicle during running will bring about traffic accidents, and many factors such as the assembling and processing quality of suspension system and steering system will lead to vehicle course angle deviation. For an in-depth study of vehicle course angle deviation, an online automatic detecting method was worked out, which can control a CCD camera to grab images by a photoelectric switch and apply image processing technique to extract key points to calculate the amount of course angle deviation.

articleTitle: Management of Barrier Housing Facilities of Laboratory Animal and Desktop Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper, we present design and Practical Significance from the use of Desktop Virtual Reality in management of Barrier Housing Facilities of Laboratory Animal. Modeling Technique adopts 3DMax and Desktop Virtual Reality technology adopts Virtual Reality Builder exploited by Technology Company of ZhongShiDian. Management of personnel, goods and animal in Barrier Housing Facilities of Laboratory Animal has been realized.

articleTitle: Stereoscopic Display on Post-Process of ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper describes an immersive visualization method for post-process of ANSYS software. The mechanism of static color fringe contour and animation of the post-process of ANSYS were researched. The stereoscopic display based on VRML files and AVI files were developed.

articleTitle: A Strong Convergence Theorem for the Equilibrium Problem and a Relatively Nonexpansive Mapping in a Banach Space
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to propose a C-Q method for finding a common element of the fixed point of the equilibrium problem and a relatively nonexpansive mapping in a Banach space, then we obtain a strong convergence theorem. The result of this paper improved and extended the results of some others in some respects.

articleTitle: Refractivity Estimation from Radar Sea Echos
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of estimating parameters of the height-dependent index of refraction over the sea surface. The parabolic approximation for numerical solution of the wave equation is used to formulate the forward model. Refractivity estimation is performed by a modified genetic algorithm(MGA). Simulation results are presented which demonstrate the ability of this approach to estimate refractivity parameters with high precision, which is likely to provide an effective method for the estimation of the duct effects from radar sea ehco.

articleTitle: The Impulsive Control of Chaos' MAS System
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The model and simulation of complex system is a hot and hard problem in the field of modern simulation. The simulative method of base on agent has becoming an important way to study complex system because of agentpsilas intelligence and autonomy. But how to control and restrict agentpsilas autonomy for the purpose of both reflecting the speciality of the complex system and avoiding falling into chaos state is a key point. The paper introduces the impulsive control into the MAS simulative system, gives a strict proof base on mathematics, and simply discusses of the applicative virtue in the field of military simulation.

articleTitle: A Multi-agent Model for Optimizing Train Formation Plan
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper, we study the freight train formation plan problem by multi-agent method. We build a decision-making scheme where the decision regarding on how to maximize the total profit and individual profit in different sets of states. We explain how to coordinate the actions of different agents and describe the cooperation mechanisms. Finally, we examine the validity and feasibility of the model by the example of simulation.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Multicomponent Voltammetric Determination throngh a Method Based on Data Mining in Chemometrics
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A novel method named WPTRBFN is presented in this paper. This method is based on radial basis function neural network (RBFN) with direct orthogonal signal correction (DOSC) and wavelet packet transform (WPT) as a pre-processing tool for the simultaneous differential pulse stripping voltammetric determination of Pb (II), Ni (II) and Cd (II). DOSC was applied to remove structured noise that is unrelated to the concentration variables. Wavelet packet representations of signals provide a local time-frequency description, thus in the wavelet packet domain, the quality of noise removal can be improved. Radial basis function network was applied for overcoming the convergence problem met in back propagation training and for facilitating nonlinear calculation. In this case, through optimization, the number of DOSC components, tolerance factor, wavelet function, decomposition level, the number of hidden nodes and the width (σ) of RBFN for the DOSCWPTRBFN method were selected as 1, 0.001, Daubechies 4, 3, 8 and 0.7 respectively. The relative standard error of prediction (RSEP) for all components with DOSCWPTRBFN, WPTRBFN, and RBFN were 4.40%, 5.87%, and 6.89% respectively. Experimental results showed the DOSCWPTRBFN method to be successful and better than others.

articleTitle: A Stochastic Hybrid Optimization Algorithm to Calibration Conceptual Hydrologic Model Parameters
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Combining the approximate gradient-based steepest descent algorithm and the pattern search algorithm the author present GP algorithm, a new local optimization algorithm for conceptual hydrologic model parameters. with Nash facticity coefficient as the target function the random search techniques was used for search parameter space, then optimize the selected parameter set using GP algorithm. The global optimization parameter is achieved by filtering parameter space strategy. The method above-mentioned comprise the derivative information and stochastic properties, make the optimization set escape the local maximum to the global set. The practical efficiency was verified by using a case in Yang Lou unite drainage basin. It was shown that parameters of hydrologic model can successfully be automatically calibrated.

articleTitle: A Collinear Scaling Algorithm with Adaptive Trust Region for Unconstrained Optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper is concerned with a collinear scaling algorithm based on adaptive trust region for unconstrained optimization. Under certain mild conditions, we establish the global convergence result of the proposed method. We can accomplish our algorithm with the simpler symmetric-rank-1 qusi-Newton updating formula. Numerical results show that the new method is efficient.

articleTitle: A New Method of Parameters Optimization of Plant Growth Posture
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Plant simulation is one of hot research fields in Computer Graphics. But the choice of model parameters is related to the simulation results directly. The paper proposed a new method that used L-system and illumination model to establish plant simulation model. And using genetic algorithms to optimize parameters, and obtain a high fitness parameters group. Experiments results indicated that group simulation model established by parameters which was optimized by GA made full use of the plant phototropism and the interaction between plants, and it can avoid cross and overcast between trees and show up the space character of tree growing preferably. Results show that plants had a better growth profile, and made a true representation of the forest growth.

articleTitle: A Rapid Image Approximation for Keypatches Building
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A new type of local features with visual semantics, keypatches, was proposed to improve performances of image retrieval methods. These features are obtained by approximating the content of scanning windows using the predefined geometrical patterns. To build keypatches quickly, this paper proposes a new approximation based on a novel compact gradient mapping table (CGMT). The method includes two stages. First, the approximation candidates can be obtained quickly by constructing and looking up the compact gradient mapping table based on the distribution sharing of the contours characteristics of the patterns. Then, Hough transform needs to be applied only in a very small parameter space defined by the candidates for the final approximation. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, we have approximated 1628 image patches from 100 images. Results show the proposed method significantly outperforms the previous Hough transform-based approximation in speed with a very small accuracy loss.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control Design for Nonlinear Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: By introducing the approximators, an indirect adaptive control method is presented for the control of a class of nonlinear systems. The proposed scheme can overcome the drawbacks of existing adaptive nonlinear control techniques which can only control minimum phase nonlinear systems and may easily result in a large control effort. The stability of closed-loop system was proved, and the convergence of the state vector to a residual set around the equilibrium, whose size can be set by the choice of several design constants is demonstrated by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Parallel Computing for Multi-train Movement Simulation on Electrified Railway
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper discusses the key issues about multi-train movement simulation on electrified railways. A simulation system has been developed for computational simulation and scheme evaluation. Computing traction power network equation is a CPU-intensive work. The Intel® architecture processors (Pentium III, Pentium4) introduces Streaming SIMD Extensions (SSE), that is an efficient execution model to accelerate of applications on a single processor. As an emphasis, the paper discusses the methods to accelerate the calculation of traction power supply. Main procedures have been redesigned by exploiting SIMD parallelism in PC platform. Some approaches about optimizing the parallel algorithm are adopted during their coding procedure such as unrolling the loop and address computation. Experimental results show that the performance of the optimized algorithm has been improved significantly. The biggest speedup ratio obtained has reached 3.35. Compared with convention algorithm, SSE algorithm enhances performance of train movement simulation more than one time.

articleTitle: Research on the Frequency-Response Characteristic of Permittivity of Qusicntinuous Plant Tissue
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The dielectric property of qusicntinuous plant tissue is studied using broad frequency impedance technology. The change of permittivity following the frequency of alternation electric field in the Potato tissue is measured within the frequency range from100 KHz to 25 MHz. By analyzing the experimental data a conclusion is drawn as follows: The permittivity of the same thickness potato tissue is whole minishing at the 1V work tension; while permittivity is increasing with the thickness at the same frequency and three minimal values of permittivity for each thickness are occurred. The frequency for each minimal value of permittivity is almost no change along with the increasing of thickness.

articleTitle: Special Effect Drivers for Camera on an Open Source Platform
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A novel embedded OpenRISC platform was developed with Altera FPGA, its source codes were based on OpenRISC1200 intellectual property (IP) core and uClinux. Five algorithms of video special effects for camera applications were proposed and integrated in the drivers, which included mirror effect, line-scanning effect, diff effect, edge blur effect and noise effect. Moreover, a front-end program interface was provided for calling specific application, which was integrated at the level of drivers rather than application program layer. Emulations and experiments show that it can satisfy application requirements.

articleTitle: Complex Dynamics of an Autonomous Prey-Predator System with Impulsive State Feedback Control
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The complex dynamics of an autonomous prey-predator system with impulsive state feedback control is studied. The sufficient conditions for the existence and stability of semi-trivial are obtained by using the Poincare map. Numerical simulations show that the complex dynamics of system we considered, including the doubling-bifurcations, chaos, etc.

articleTitle: Production Control Modeling of Integrated RE System Based on MAS
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: To improve the intelligent and cooperative performance of the integrated reverse engineering system, a control model based on the architecture of Multi-Agent System (MAS) was constructed. This model consisted of three layers: the management Agent layer, the cell Agent layer and the execution Agent layer. The management Agent layer was in charge of coordinating, scheduling and managing all Agents. Each Agent in the cell Agent layer finished the task by cooperation and executed the first step of distribution. The execution Agent layer was responsible for the hardware and software in RE system. According to the local resources information and current status, it accepted the tasks assigned by the cell Agents and resolved the tasks. Agents in the same layer were in distributed structure and equal cooperation. The superior and subordinate Agents adopted the master and menial cooperation. The control model based on MAS improved the cooperative and real-time and reconstructive performance.

articleTitle: The Design of Hardware-in-the-Loop Simulation Based on Electric-Drive's Mathematical Model
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper utilizes the hardware-in-the-loop simulation technology, researching on the locomotive electric signal, has designed the locomotive electric signal simulation installment and the locomotive movement transmission simulation test bench. This text in view of the primary capability parameters of AC-DC electric-drive system under the trainpsilas running state. Then makes a research in the ideal running characteristic, the adjusting characteristic, the speed regulation characteristic of electromotor with the theory of AC-DC electric-drive and establishes it mathematics model. The electric drive mathematical model can provide the locomotive running status for the test platform to come to the locomotive transmission characteristic simulation experiment.

articleTitle: The ANSYS Analysis of Predominant Period Varication under the Site Vibration
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Explore the analysis of the three dimensioned finite element and the dynamical time-domain analysis for actural earth layerpsilas earthquake reflection after the site condition has been changed ,and to discuss the ANSYS analysis of the predominant period varication under the site vibration by enlarging the acceleration effect of the ground rock summit.

articleTitle: Health Management Service System Study Based on the Grid
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This thesis puts forward an innovative model of health management service grid, and gives the overall architecture of health management grid platform system by which a health management service model can be established based on the analysis of present condition of health management in China. This paper also presents a new integrated model about the health management service resources by using the advanced Internet concept of grid service. The system can on one hand promote peoplepsilas enthusiasms and initiatives to get more involved in health management, and on the other hand push forward the development of health management service industry.

articleTitle: Transpose-Free Gl-BCG Algorithm for Linear Systems with Multiple Right-Hand Sides
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In the present paper, we present a new transpose-free global method for solving large nonsymmetric linear systems with multiple right-hand sides. We first give the scalar polynomial interpretation of the classical global biconjugate gradient algorithm using formal orthogonal polynomials. The global conjugate gradient squared algorithm can be derived by using this. Although related to the transpose of a matrix, the global conjugate gradient squared algorithm does not need multiplication by the transpose of a matrix. We also show to apply the method for solving the Lyapunov matrix equation. Finally, some numerical examples are given to illustrate the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Individualized Exercise Energy Expenditure Models and Its Application in Walking-Running Exercise Prescription
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: According to the data measured by gas metabolism experiments, this paper analyzed the energy consuming and oxygen uptake in exercises, the relationship between oxygen uptake and age, weight, gender, and burthen, as well as the relationship between burthen and exercise intensity. Relation models of different variables are established separately to derivate individualized sports energy consuming models. This paper explores the applications of the model in establishing of walking-running exercises prescription, and provided a feasible plan for scientific walking-running exercises. The value in practice and application is obviously.

articleTitle: Creep Model on Simulating In-mold Stress in Injection Molded Polymers
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In-mold stress may occur for injection molded parts during the cooling stage. It not only affects the shrinkage of the part, but also has great influence on its mechanical properties. In this paper, stress-strain response was studied under the action of temperature and packing pressure in the process of injection molding. Furthermore, a new model was set to simulate the level of in-mold stresses in injection molded parts, and its creep constitutive equation was obtained. Instead of dealing with viscoelastic parameters of the polymer with WLF equation, the viscous factor was calculated with inversion method and the formula of elastic module was directly derived from P-V-T equation. The in-mold stresses in injection molded plates were simulated with the model. The results revealed that the new approach is reliable and accurate.

articleTitle: Application of ADINA to Modeling of Fluid-Structure Interaction in Buried Liquid-Conveying Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Finite element modeling of buried liquid-conveying pipeline for the calculation of fluid structure interaction is the key to analyze the damage of long distance buried liquid-conveying pipeline. Because the influence of site, fault movement, and earthquake, etc. it is necessary to calculate fluid-structure interaction (FSI) in finite element analysis under pipe-soil interaction. Finite element model of buried liquid-conveying pipeline for the calculation of fluid structure interaction is constructed through combination of ADINA-parasolid and ADINA-native modeling methods, and the direct computing method of two-way fluid-structure coupling is introduced. Pipe-soil friction is defined in solid model, special flow assumption and fluid structure interface condition are defined in fluid model. Damage of buried liquid-conveying pipeline is investigated through computing of fluid-structure coupling. Results are analyzed, and some advice is proposed.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experiment of the Magnetic Stress Method Based on the Amorphous Alloy
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Amorphous alloy material has good soft magnetic properties, so it can be used for stress measurement. At first, the working principle of the stress measurement was analyzed. Secondly its output characteristic mathematical model was established by adopting multivariate linear regression analysis method, and the simulation of the mathematical model was made based on Matlab. Finally a practice measurement with Fe-base TM-M Amorphous alloy was completed. The results of the test have showed that the stress measurement method has some characteristics of being sensitiveness to measure and simple to make a testing system, and a promising method of measuring stress.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Conspiring Condition between Supervisor and Contractor during the Project Construction Process
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Recently, domestic project construction seriously loses its credit. The generally downturn quality is mainly because contractors conspire with supervisors, using its information superiority, constructing without following the requests. This consequently bring injurious to the client and public interest. The essay analyzed the conspiring condition between supervisor and contractor during project construction process and problems existed in supervision with tripartite game model, then provided some solutions and recommendations.

articleTitle: A Type of Standardization Issues and Numerical Simulation of the Digital Camera
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper discusses a type of standardization issues of the digital camera with distortion ,and includes numerical simulation and precision test, has a practical significance.

articleTitle: Temperature Field Simulation and Analysis of Cylinder-Jacket Component of Diesel Engine Based on Fluid-Solid-Heat Coupling
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A four-stroke direct injection diesel engine is taken as the study object, and a cylinder-jacket-coolant-piston coupling model is built up. With the research method of fluid- solid-heat coupling, the computational regions of both fluid and solid are coupled, which are separated in traditional temperature-field computation, and the puzzle of iterating difficultly due to the differences of temperature governing equations and numerical algorithms is solved. Using the finite volume method to discretize and solve the whole computational field, more accurate and more reliable results are achieved. The numerical model and the coupling computational method employed here are significant to the optimization designs of diesel engine thermal strength as well as the cooling system.

articleTitle: A New Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm with Adaptive Mutation Operator
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The paper presents a new particle swarm optimization algorithm with adaptive mutation operator. In the algorithm, a new adaptive mutation operator is given by fitness variance and space position aggregation degree and implemented at the best position of each particle at each iteration. The experiments on six problems show that the modified PSO algorithm can increases diversity of swarm and greatly enhance the ability to leap the local optimization.

articleTitle: Local One Dimensional Scheme for Viscous Wave Equations
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A new second order local one dimensional finite difference scheme is established for two dimensional viscous wave equations. Stability and a second order discrete L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> norm error estimates are obtained for the scheme. Finally, some numerical examples show the efficiency of the scheme.

articleTitle: Project Management and Workflow Analysis of Agile Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Agile manufacturing (AM) is a typical concurrent and collaborative way between different enterprises and different departments in order to meet market requirement for time, cost and quality as soon as possible. From the point of view, AM is special project management. Agile manufacturing and project management (PM) have many same characteristics. The characteristics and relations of AM and PM are discussed firstly. The resources of the manufacturing enterprise alliances have characteristics such as autonomous, distributed, heterogeneous, dynamic, and so on. Therefore, the PM of AM is different from traditional PM. Secondly, a typical workflow of agile manufacturing is illustrated. Then the architecture of PM of agile manufacturing is proposed and analyzed, which includes some key technologies to support good project management. Combining the automation and standards of the workflow with the PM of high quality is a good solution to agile manufacturing. Finally, the technologies of information exchange and communication mechanism are introduced.

articleTitle: The Design of IF Delay Line in Spread Spectrum Communication Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In view of the high temperaturepsilas stability of the SAW tap delay line requested and the lower precision questions and so on, a new method is put forward to apply a new multi-element logic circuit based on FPGA in IF delay line in spreading spectrum communication. The scheme is given to design the numerical control one-way analog scanning switch, the key component in the delay line. The simulation result indicates that the system can realize the function of the analog/digit IF signal numerical control delay, and reduce the circuit's complexity greatly. It is prossessed of the advantages of precise delay time, wider bandwidth and lower price. Especially, the shorter delay time and the wider bandwidth enable this design method to apply in higher communication speed easily.

articleTitle: Study on Digitized Inspecting Technique for Complex Casting Part Based on Reverse Engineering
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A digitized inspecting technique based on reverse engineering and its application workflow are put forward for measuring the complex part. It is studied on the key technologies, such as a synthetic method of spot cloud data processing based on Uniformly Sampling and Chordal Deviation Sampling, alignment with spot-cloud and CAD model of the part taking the three datum-planes as reference feature. The fabricating errors of casting part with complex structure is inspected fleetly and accurately by means of this technique. The technique can be proved as a new computer aided inspecting (CAI) technology, which can be used to solve the technical bottleneck for measuring complex part. The precision and the speed of digitized inspection are observably improved, furthermore, it is more significant for realization of automated, flexible,and digitized inspecting approach.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Performance Assessment of Scientific Research Works in Local Institutions of Higher Learning
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The performance assessment of scientific research works in local institutions of higher learning acts as an important part in scientific research management. At present, there exist such problems in the PA system as improper assessment index, lacking of systematicness in its system, excessive focus on the results, lacking of scientificalness, irrational interest guidance leading to an action for quick result and immediate profit and to the impetuous mind, ignorance of team performance etc. Facing the problems, local colleges and universities must, based on their own situations, adhere to the principles of uniform target, guidance quality, systematicness, comparability etc., trying to establish a systematic, multi-level and comprehensive PA system.

articleTitle: The Construction of 3D-Mannequin Based on Human Body Characteristic Lines
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The method of 3D-mannequin reconstruction with divisional surfaces brought forward in this article is based on body characteristic lines and NURBS theory: regularizing original data through scanning, constructing mannequinpsilas unit surfaces with regularized data, joining every unit surface and reconstructing 3D-mannequin with characteristic lines.

articleTitle: Techniques of Radio Frequency Identification and Anti-collision in Digital Feeding Dairy Cattle
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper, a new RFID system to identify the different dairy cattle is designed based on detailed research of radio frequency identification technology. The binary search algorithm is adopted. To reduce the data exchanging time, an improved binary search algorithm is proposed. The experiment results showed that the new system could prevent the conflicting caused by two or more cows stepping in the frequency field at the same time, and ensure that the sensor information matched that of the individual dairy cattle.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Fixing Test Paper Algorithm Based on Cultural Algorithms and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: According to the feature that genetic algorithm (GA) is adapted to requirement of culture algorithms (CA) framework, GA is as the population space of CA and these two Algorithms are applied to the intelligent fixing test paper strategy research by combining. This method guides the population evolution efficiently through belief space and speeds up convergence. The experimental results prove that the algorithm keeps good average fitness and high operating efficiency.

Author Keywords: Strategy of Intelligent Fixing Test paper

articleTitle: A Blind De-convolution Technique for Machine Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Blind source separation (BSS) is a powerful signal processing technique, based on the advantage of data mining and handing. The observed signal containing too much redundancy information, the application of BSS in machine vibration signals is a new method for feature extracting. The traditional BSS model usually neglect that machine vibration signal always is wideband signal for it can be viewed as sums of differently convolved source, and non-stationary, which will brings the dissatisfactory effects for machine fault diagnosis. In this paper, the BSS technique based on second-order statistic been expended to blind de-convolution (BD), combined the advantage of time-frequency analysis (TFA), a TFA-BD algorithm is proposed for machine vibration signal. The experimental result of the numerical simulation data and the actually measuring data shows that the method is efficiency. Comparable with traditional BSS, the performance index of separation can be increased by once at least. The method is suitable for machine vibration signal processing and fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of Service Delay of Battlefield Information Delivery Model
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Information delivery service(IDS) is an important part of Information Grid and with the expansion of network and users, Quality of Service(QoS) has been the basic requirement of IDS. The architecture of Content Delivery Network, the frame of Data Delivery Service and the property of Battle Formation(BF) are firstly analyzed and a battlefield information delivery model is put forward based on BF, which also provides the mechanism for information submitting, searching and receiving. Besides this, a delivery method based on information type and a strategy to process information with priority are present, which are paid more attentions on battlefield, and the analysis on it is also provided, theoretical analysis and simulation verify the effectiveness of the methods proposed.

articleTitle: A Mistake Application for Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: When solving multivariate sample data, principal component analysis (PCA) can simplify the source, reduce the dimension of redundancies, and make the new variable uncorrelated, so it is widely utilized in multivariate statistical analysis. These years, however, some people apply the PCA to determine the weight of evaluation index system, even include the method in the textbook. This paper will clarify the unscientific method of valuing the weight in two ways.

articleTitle: Solving the Linear Variational Inequality by Interval Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper presents a solution to linear variational inequality by interval evolution strategies based on the question that iterative algorithm of traditional numerical computer can not satisfy parallel in solving variational inequality. The numerical solution used to solve linear variational inequality with interval evolution strategies sufficiently exerted the advantage of evolution strategies such as group search and global convergence, and it satisfies the question of parallel solute the linear variational inequality in engineering technique. The numerical computation results indicate that the algorithm offers an effective way to solve linear variational inequality, high convergence rate, high accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Study on Pseudo-attitude Determination Technology Based on Single-Antenna GPS Receiver
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: High-tech GPS plays a crucial role to the vigorous development of spatial sciences and applications, GPS attitude determination technology is an important application of GPS. However, the technology of pseudo-attitude determination based on single-antenna GPS receiver is still in its infancy stage, a large number of simulation experiments have proved the feasibility of this new method, but it is still a lack of the actual authentication. First of all, we do a general introduction to the whole structure of the attitude determination system. And then we analyze the key parts, including the kalman filter and the pseudo-attitude model. Based on this attitude model, we carry out simulations which has illustrated this new technology is very suitable for high_speed flight. Finally, a new system mainly including the high-precision SuperStar GPS receiver and PC104 computer is tested. The results have shown that the system based on single antenna had the high precision, which could meet the requirements of conventional attitude determination. Whatpsilas more , some important applications of the pseudo-attitude determination system are be simply listed in chapter six and chapter seven.

articleTitle: Optimum Segmentation of Digital Planar Curves Using Quadric Bézier Curves
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper presents a dynamic programming algorithm to detect dominant points within a planar digital curve by approximating the given curve with quadric Bezier curves. Normally, people use cubic or higher curves to piecewise approximate a given curve, and the main job is to achieve an accurate approximation instead of dominant point detection. While using cubic or higher curves in the process of detecting dominant points of a planar curve, although a higher accuracy is achieved, the computational complexity is high too. In this paper we propose an algorithm using quadric Beziers instead of circular arcs and lines to approximate the given curve. Compare with previous algorithms our method gets more reasonable results without increasing the computational complexity.

articleTitle: Development and Evaluation of Linear Characteristic of a Complex Flexure Hinge
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper concentrates on the development and evaluation of linear characteristics of a complex flexure hinge with high accuracy and large stiffness. The flexure hinge mechanism is used to clamp the shaft of a micropositioning stage based on the inchworm principle. Six key parameters of the flexure hinge are optimized by using finite element method. Developed flexure hinge has very good effects on the clamping and resilience that are accurate and reasonable. The evaluation result shows that the flexure hinge has excellent linear characteristic.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation on Structural Stability of Different Types of Surge Shaft - Illustrated with a Case Study of a Large Scale Underground Complex
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The long gallery type and cylinder type are the two main types of surge shaft in large scale hydropower underground complexes. The assessment method using FEM calculation results to analyze the structural stability of different types of surge shaft in large scale underground complexes is put forward. Firstly, the general FEM procedure to simulate underground excavation is proposed. Then, the FEM-based stability assessment method is expounded by introducing certain stability indexes. Such indexes are the distribution and volumes of plastic and crack zone, the magnitude of plastic dissipation energy and the distribution of deformation and stress around surrounding rock. A case study is further illustrated with the simulation of different types of surge shaft in a large scale hydropower underground complex. The comparison results shows that the proposed numerical method and corresponding stability assessment indexes are effective and reliable in evaluating different types of surge shaft. And it is concluded that the surrounding rock stability of cylinder typed surge shaft is more favorable than the long gallery typed surge shaft.

articleTitle: Study of Software Security Based on SLDMRP Multicast Routing Protocol
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: To focus on the current problem from the multicast routing protocols that are only considered about them, and then rarely take the security needs of less common into account. It is an ideal state protocol that is established without any infrastructure communications. During the procedure of data transfer, it is extremely vulnerable to eavesdrop, swindle, tampering or replay (Relay) routing information security. Thus, the SLDMRP protocol that it based on security put forward in this paper. This protocol is designed on the basis of the multicast routing LDMRP, while this protocol creating and maintaining multicast group, sending control message, to carry out security policy that is underwritten and verified the data packets, in order to prevent the control message from eavesdropping and tampering. Finally, through simulation results show that its security strategy is effective.

articleTitle: Development of Uniform Hardware Driver for Real-Time Windows and xPC Target
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Real-time windows target (RTWT) and xPC Target are two MATLAB/Simulink toolboxes used for real time simulation, prototyping, testing, and deploying real-time systems, but the application is greatly limited due to lack of enough hardware drivers.
