abstract: The calculations of the temperature fields, the residual stress distributions and the displacement distributions of welding process by using three-dimensional thermo-elastic-plastic FEM (finite element method) are time-consuming. Some high efficiency computational methods aiming at characteristics of welding process in welding process numerical simulation were proposed such as segmented moving heat source, adaptive mesh technique, similitude principles, special transition element, material modeling at high temperature and parallel computation etc. It has proved that using one method mentioned above can reduce the solution time of welding process numerical simulation. In this paper a butt weld of a thin aluminum plate is investigated by means of three-dimensional thermo-elastic-plastic FEM on the basis of commercial software ABAQUS. Four schemes are carried out for achieving the calculation efficiency of different schemes: (a) moving heat source with solid element; (b) segmented moving heat source with solid element; (c) moving heat source with shell to solid transition; (d) segmented moving heat source with shell to solid transition. The simulated results show that although in the weld zone the residual stress distributions have some difference, the residual stress distributions are very close away from weld zone for four schemes. The comparison of the computational time for the four schemes indicates that segmented moving heat source with shell to solid transition not only can reduce the calculation time but also can improve the efficiency of modeling process compared to the other schemes.

articleTitle: A Method of Reconstruction Building's 3D Model from Perspective Images
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: According to the character of the basic elements in buildings, through analysis the principles of perspective and the geometric relations, novel approaches to determine 3D coordinates of the basic elements from perspective image by the distribution of vanishing points, and then perform it by VLISP in AutoCAD.

articleTitle: Queuing Network Models Analysis Based on CPN
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A Queuing Network Models analysis method based on CPN is put forward. The method transformed queuing network models to hierarchical Colored Petri Nets model. It added monitors into models to monitor the state of networks using CPN-Tools and collected data during simulation. Then performance of queuing network is evaluated using collected data and simulation reports. This method can not only avoid the problem of the state space, but also adapt to solve large-scale queuing network models because of hierarchical structure.

articleTitle: The Security of Collaborative Commerce Based on Service Oriented Architecture
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the requirements to the security of collaborative commerce system based on service oriented architecture, a security solution which can solve the security problem is proposed. The solution includes some technologies such as XML encryption, authority access control, signatures and intrusion detection, etc.

articleTitle: Active Control of Vehicle Interior Noise Based on Selective Attenuation Method
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Based on the Least Square Mean method which is broadly applied on the active noise control technology, the paper calculated the frequency selective LMS algorithm and created the model for the application of the algorithm on active noise control; and was modeled and analyzed the adaptive attenuation simulation with single tone noise signal and narrow band noise signal demonstrating on the platform of Matlab/Simulink, after the control parameters of filter performance parameters and step size and filter length of adaptive filter was decided. The simulation result showed obvious counteract effect of noice signal, it was identical with theoretic solution and the presented algorithm was valid.

articleTitle: Research on the Test System of the MSW Compactor Experiment Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: According to the actuality of the systemic test on the compactor machine of MSW(municipal solid waste), a combined scheme relateing to virtual system based on Lab VIEW is put forward. This article is aimed at studying on the compacting characteristics of the experiment flat so as to design the advanced system for the purpose of compaction and data acquisition and disposal further. Meanwhile, the design process of the system's software and hardware are discribed as well the result of the program debugging. The realtime curves about data acquisition and disposal are gained through simulation in the LabVIEW. And by contrast in the experiment, a conclusion is drawed that the effect of the wedge-shape compaction is better than the plane-shape compaction. So the compaction angle should be adjusted during the compaction process. Under the requirements, the system's function can be expanded through programming. All in all, the system can greatly satisfy the requirements of the test.

articleTitle: A Model on Location Decision for Distribution Centers of Emergency Food Logistics
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The paper establishes an evaluation index system of location decision on distribution centers of emergency food logistics. Then it puts forward a model combining Radial Basis Function Neural Network (RBFNN) with improved Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) algorithm, which has not only the capability of high non-linear mapping via neural network, but also the characteristics of high efficiency, global convergence, and distributed calculation via improved ACO algorithm. The location decision on distribution centers of emergency food logistics can be made through the model on the premise of efficiency, safety and reliability. Finally, a simulation example is demonstrated to show the model is effective and applicable.

articleTitle: The Calculation of Torsional Acceleration of Seismic Wave and the Application in Frame Structural
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Abstract—This paper will introduce the principle of obtaining seismic wave’s torsional acceleration component from it’s translation component, and it gets the torsional component of EI Centro wave and Ninghe wave through the Matlab calculation program.Using ANSYS software, the spatial elasticplastic analysis model of frame structural is established,and then, the translational and rotational component of the seismic wave was input to the frame structural model ,and carried out the elastic-plastic time-history analysis on it. The results show that torsional component of seismic wave has a great influence on frame structural, it should be considered when designing.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation for Complete Fluidic Sprinkler
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The complete fluidic sprinkler was originally created by China. No numerical simulation study in the sprinkler could be found in recent literature research paper The mathematical model for the inner flow of the complete fluidic sprinkler was established using computational fluid dynamics for the first time. The flow-pressure relationship and wall inclination of the main jet had been simulated. The calculated results were compared with the experimental results. The results of theoretical analysis, experiments and numerical simulation were in good agreement.

articleTitle: An Agent-Based Automatic Services Composition Algorithm of Mobile Collaboration Platform
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Aiming at the automatic composition issue of services in mobile collaboration platform, an agent-based automation service composition algorithm was proposed in this paper. Firstly, the status of service composition and agent technology was analyzed in depth. Then, transfer the semantic service to the equivalence action of agent plan. Based on it, the semantic service automation composition was carried out through building action intention of agent. The algorithm has been applied to the platform that supporting mobile collaboration service. The practice indicates the algorithm can effectively implement the automation composition of mobile collaboration service.

articleTitle: Imitation of Plants Inflorescence Based on Fusion of L-System and IFS
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Plants simulation is one of the research domains which are full of challenges. Since the L-System and IFS both have limitations in the field of plant inflorescence simulation, the images of plant organs generated by using L-System or IFS are lack of enough real changes. The paper proposed a method that integrated iterated function system with L-System using Visual Basic 6.0 as development environment for programming tools, and produced plant inflorescence finally which was more realistic.

articleTitle: A Heterogeneous Sensors Track-to-Track Correlation Algorithm Based on Fuzzy Numbers Similarity Degree
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In the distributed multi-sensor information fusion system composed of 2-D radar and infrared sensor, the problem of the track-to-track correlation is sophisticated because the types of the sensors are different and both of them donpsilat possess the consistent measurement space, this paper presents a heterogeneous sensors track correlation algorithm based on fuzzy number similarity degree. In this algorithm, each trackpsilas bearing information is considered as a discrete function of time, after performed temporal and spatial alignment, synchronizing the asynchronous bearing information of the track come from each sensor to the same reference time scale on the same coordinate system , the fuzzy number of each bearing information is calculated by using triangular membership function, the similarity degree between every two fuzzy numbers is calculated, then ,the similarity degreepsilas matrix of fuzzy number of bearing information is formed and the track correlation pairs are determined based on the similarity degreepsilas matrix .The results of simulation experiment show that this algorithm can effectively accomplish track-to-track correlation for the heterogeneous sensors consisting of radar and infrared sensor.

articleTitle: Study on Information Management Optimization for CAPP by GA
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The development of the CAPP system based on the PDM system and explores some key technologies of the system integration about CAPP/PDM and CAD/CAPP. With the rapid development of theory, method and technology about PDM, this paper firstly takes an in-depth study on implemental method and relative technology about PDM being the framework of CAPP to support the integration of information. In order to obtain a reasonable information management quickly and economically, this paper brings forward the resolving scheme using GA (genetic algorithm) to achieve the information management optimization of process planning. In the research of project, we havenpsilat completed the coding of all information of product for the time is very limit, but the methods are viable and effective through simple calculation. Adopting the calculate method, the information is managed effective through this method.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis and Comparison on Stress between Male and Female Academic Faculty in Chinese Universities
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The primary objective is to verify the sex gap between male and female facultypsilas stress by numerical analysis. We used self-made questionnaire on source of stress to collect data. By descriptive statistics, chi-square test and numerical analysis, the results indicate that both male and female faculty are experiencing stress slightly strong and female faculty experience less stress than their male counterparts, but male faculty report higher shares strong and slightly strong ability to cope with the stress than female faculty.

articleTitle: Study on Repair Fatigue Damage of Axle Shaft Mechanical Parts
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Axle shaft is a most commonly axial mechanical part. Because of bearing bending and torsion loading at the same time, fatigue damage is a kind of common form to shaft part. So repair of fatigue is very important. In this paper, a theoretical model of fatigue damage of the materials was established, the value of the damage was calculated, the mechanism of fatigue damage and repairing of the shaft were studied in macro, meso and micro aspects. It was found that the segregated distributing of particles in the second phase of materials has played an important role in initiating, nucleating of fatigue damage, forming and expansion of micro-cracks. First of all, initiation of cracks is in the place of Cr-rich particles or with the Cr carbide particles in the second phase of material. Fatigue damage of the shaft is repaired by the way of heat treatment. Tests have been done in several aspects such as the choices of tempering opportunity, temperatures, methods, cooling and so on. After analysis to the results of the tests, it was found that there are some effects on the repair of fatigue damage of the shaft is different in different materials. The effect of repairing to the fatigue damage is more evident for the shaft made of 40Cr steel than that of 45steel. The accumulated fatigue life of the shaft has been raised by tempering. It was found that the materials can remember the tempering temperature that is used in the past. There is a temperature threshold in choosing tempering temperatures when repairing fatigue damage of the materials.

articleTitle: A Web Information Retrieval Optimization Based on Hub Sites
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The rapid development of the Internet brings a new problem, which is how to rapidly and effectively retrieve needed information from vast number of Web pages. In this paper, we propose a valid approach to find hub sites using hill-climbing algorithms .It uses a fuzzy clustering algorithm based on Web pagespsila contents and link analysis in order to help uses find relevant Web information more easily and precisely. This paper focuses on improving the effectiveness and efficiency of Web search.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Discrete Hopfield Neural Networks with Weighted Function Matrix and Delay
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper, discrete Hopfield neural networks with weight function matrix (DHNNWFM) and discrete Hopfield neural networks with weight function matrix and delay (DHNNWFMD) are introduced. And the stability properties of DHNNWFMD that weight function matrix is a symmetric function matrix are studied. And we obtain a important result that If the weight function matrix is a symmetric function matrix and delayed matrix is a column diagonally dominant matrix, DHNNWFMD will converge to a state in serial mode. It provides some theory basis for the application of DHNNWFMD.

articleTitle: Implementation and Performance Analyses of Anycast QoS Routing Algorithm Based on Genetic Algorithm in NS2
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: As a new communication mode, anycast brings along challenges and opportunities for domestic and international researchers. The quality of anycast service mainly relies on the selection of QoS routing. Aiming at the proposed anycast routing algorithm, this paper introduces its disadvantages on the experimental analyses and its advantages of simulation based on NS2. It then focuses on a proposed anycast routing algorithm by introducing how it is simulated based on NS2 and analyzing its algorithm performance.

articleTitle: The Study on Service Oriented Access Control Model
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: With the fast development of Internet, distributed isomer system increases in double-click. New access control method and universal access control module should be come up to reduce software cost and solve the problem of complexity system access control, which working flow and transaction are imported in system. For this purpose, the role, process and resource-based three-dimensional access control method is put forward in the paper. Then role, process and resource-based Service Oriented- architecture access control model is designed. New idea of access control module separated from system is put forward in this paper. This access control module adopts Service Oriented- Architecture and whole access control module is created as web service, which can be published in UDDI registry center and invocated by other isomer systems. So other systems can use this universal access control service module to control system data and functionspsila access. At last, the realization of SOA-based access control is described.

articleTitle: An Analysis on the Sharing of Educational Resources in Distance Education by Grid Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The essence of the modern distance education is the share of educational resources. This text aims to analyze the problems which affect the share of educational resources, such as the lack of the excellent educational network resources, the mass repeated constructions of the resources, the poor ability of intelligentized searches for resources, the difference between the network and the operative system, which have great influences on the data share among the systems, consequently they produce several information isolated islands one by one and the hardness of making mutual operation. The text also points out what limitations can be overcome by the grid education based on the grid technology, which can eliminate the information-isolated islands, and knowledge-isolated islands and realize the intelligentized searches of information and knowledge resources. As a result, this is a better way to solve the resources share problems. Also this text aims to probe a little further about the resource share modes of the distance education based on the grid technology.

articleTitle: FPGA-accelerated Design of Motion Estimation for H.264 HDTV
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: H.264/AVC is a merging popular video coding standard which have new features. A H.264 open source, X264 code set, adopt motion estimation which consists of diamond search, hexagonal search, uneven multi-hexagon search, exhaustive search and hadamard exhaustive search. According to statistic values, the time-consuming of ME operations during HDTV(1920x1080p) encoding is about 60-80 percent within whole H.264 algorithm. Considering the characteristics of FPGAs, flexibility, inherent parallel characteristic and the rapid prototyping, a parallel operation architecture of FPGA-based was designed with a Lattice ECP2M chip. The experiment results which include the time-consuming, the wave forms and the calculation cycles were analyzed with special tools, ispLever 6.1, ModelSim, etc. and the Post-Place & Route layout of a project was shown in the end of this paper. It is concluded that the FPGA chip can deal with HDTV sequences as a co-processor in a video coding system.

articleTitle: Qualitative Simulation Modeling of Complex System on SCM
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper describes the qualitative simulation modeling applied to a supply chain management. The main objective is to use complex system modeling methods to model the SCM (supply chain management) and then to determine the main parameters which have influence on the performance of the SCM. In this paper, the time series of the demand information from the customers will be analyzed and the forecasting and inventory policies would be discussed according to the analysis. The results of this paper will be listed finally, and some other research should be completed.

articleTitle: Dual-Screw Profile Extruder Fuzzy-Control System Based on LonWorks
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper study a dual-screw profile extruder with erose taper used in PVC-U molding processing, presents a temperature computer control system in which a combined-control strategy of on-off control, fuzzy-control and integral-control were adaptive elected. Lonworks were adopted as system fieldbus to construct a net to regulate the extruderpsilas sub-areas temperature in line. App effect shows that the temperature control precision is plusmn1% and the method of multi-subarea control in line with Lonworks filedbus has better effect than those sub-areas self-governed control, and can prevent PVC-U decompounding in the processing effectively, so the character of PVC-U manufacture could be improved.

articleTitle: Finite Volume Method for Time-Dependent Convection Diffusion Large Reynolds Number Problem
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Time-dependent convection diffusion equation, with a discontinuous data and large Reynolds number, is examined. This kind of problem leads to interior layer phenomena due to the discontinuity. The solution changes rapidly near interior layer. Traditional finite volume method is applied. Two efficient numerical methods are constructed. One is Shishkin's finite volume method. Another is Improved-Shishkin's finite volume method. Shishkin's finite volume method applies Shishkin's idea to construct mesh partition. Improved-Shishkin's finite volume method applies multi-transition points technique to reconstruct mesh partition near interior layer. Numerical experiments indicate that both methods are well fitted the property of interior layer. Both methods are uniformly convergence scheme. Improved-Shishkin's finite volume method is more accurate than finite difference method, which is constructed by Farrell in his previous paper.

articleTitle: Globally Exponential Lag Synchronization of Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper, we investigates synchronization dynamics of complex networks by using proper nonlinear feedback controllers. By consider a new family of modified hyperchaotic systems as a note, globally exponential lag synchronization (GELS) of the complex model is studied, and Lyapunov stability criteria for the globally exponential lag synchronization is derived. Numerical simulations are used to illustrate the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Simulation of Interfacial Stress in TBCs with Oxidation-Resistance Interlayer under Thermal Loading
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Plasma-sprayed Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> interlayer was prefabricated between the bondcoat and topcoat in thermal barrier coatings. It can prevent oxygen penetration through the interconnected porosity in the topcoat, so that the thermally grown oxide (TGO) growth and the failure can be suppressed. But, prefabricated Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> interlayer will result in interfacial stress redistributing. The paper, basing on three-dimensional shape of thermal barrier coatings, using elastic sphere model, considering topcoat, interlayer, TGO and bondcoat, have developed a four-concentric-sphere model of three-dimensional, and produced the relevant analytical model. Furthermore, to verify the results by FEM. In this paper, the analysis of anti-oxidation layer for the concave and convex asperity, indicate that the method can simulate the effect of interlayer on the interfacial microstructurepsilas stress distributing of thermal barrier coatings.

articleTitle: Trademark Image Retrieval Based on Shape and Key Local Color Features
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: An combined trademark image retrieval method based on shape and the key local color features is proposed. First , retrieve images with a wavelet modulus maxima algorithm based on the self-adaptive threshold using the shape features. Second, retrieve using the key local color features which contained the colorspsila statistic and local distributing characteristics. At last, set a weight considering the similarity degree of the shape and color. The experimental results indicated that this algorithm can retrieve similar trademark images fast and efficiently, and improve the recall ratio and precision ratio.

articleTitle: A New Bit Synchronization Method for an Ultra-Tightly Integrated GPS Receiver
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: We developed a novel INS assisted bit synchronization algorithm for an Ultra-Tightly integrated GPS receiver. This algorithm computes an estimate of the bit energy for all possible bit boundary candidates and chooses that candidate which maximizes the energy. It uses INS assisted extended Kalman filters to track and remove the error in the carrier parameters. Computer simulations show a superior performance of this bit synchronization at very weak signal powers. The bit synchronization achieves a high bit edge detection rate and optimal bit error rate even at very low power signals.

articleTitle: Incremental FP_Growth Mining Algorithm Based on Web Information Extraction
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper studies the incremental updating problem of frequent itemsets when the transaction database and the minimum support change in the Web information extraction. An algorithm of incremental FP_Growth mining based on frequent pattern tree is proposed and used to extract the transaction data in the second-hand IT trading site and generate association rules. Analysis and test show that the algorithm is efficient and feasible.

articleTitle: Thermal Behavior of Composite Girder Bridges
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: For composite girder bridges, thermal effects could not be ignored which is significant when compared to dead or live load effects. Temperature distributions involved in concrete bridges and composite girder bridges are at best different due to dissimilar material properties and cross sections. This paper presents the characteristics of the temperature field for composite girder bridges. The relationship between the ambient temperature field and the structural temperature field is analyzed. The principle of Fourier heat theory is adopted to establish a numerical model for the composite girder. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. Based on this, the structural temperature filed can be simplified as the thermal gradient for composite girder bridges, which has practical value in the design for reasonable controlling the thermal displacement.

articleTitle: A New Spot-Checking Management System for Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: It is one of the important measures for power plants running safely to take spot-checking management, know performance of equipments, discover potential hazard and abnormity of equipments in time, and avoid the faults of equipment in the early. The equipment management in some power plants is irregular and some advanced technologies is not be used adequately. The methods of spot-checking management are researched. Using .NET technologies and modularization design, the management system of spot-checking for power plants is presented. The system takes full use of the powerful database management system. The whole structure, working process and key technologies are introduced. The mixed mode based on B/S mode and C/S mode is used to build the network of spot-checking for the whole plant. It is proved that the system is reasonable in design, simple and reliable in operation, full in function, and good in expansibility, effective in use.

articleTitle: ID-Based Key-Insulated Electronic Cash System with Multiple Banks
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The basic idea behind an ID-based cryptosystem is that user's public key can be determined by his identity information. Comparing with the traditional certificate-based cryptography, ID-based cryptography can eliminate much of the overhead associated with the deployment and management of certificate. However, exposure of private keys can be the most devastating attack on a public key based cryptosystem since such that all security guarantees are lost. An ID-based key-insulated electronic cash system with multiple banks is presented. For solving the problem of key exposure of the basic scheme, the technique of key insulation is applied.

articleTitle: Experimentation Message Management System Based on VB.NET
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Some problems of file uploading always come across at developing of Web site. In this paper we introduced a way of uploading file which edited with VB.NET in the experimental systems. We emphasized to discuss the theory of uploading file which edited by VB.NET, to achieve the key factor of file uploading based on Web mode , principally to comprehend devising project and assaying theory and editing and debugging procedure at laboratory of transferring data from browse to Web sever, to pass by elaborating tissue and completed, fully meets with user's actual situation and operating requirements. The devised software has completed software planning of requirements tasks, the system based of customer's requirement, remains to more improve and perfection. There are very complications to use some scripts dealing with this problem. The system has successfully developed and has good developing prospects in experimental systems, which have valuable experience on the experimental teaching in colleges.

articleTitle: Application of Femap in Electromagnetic Field Simulation
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: A finite element analysis program was compiled by the author by means of Femap Application Programming Interface (API), and Femap became useful in electromagnetic filed simulation. In this paper, a model of current-carrying solenoid is built in Femap, the finite element analysis results are presented, and some key codes in the program are given.

articleTitle: A Method of Detecting Peanut Cultivars and Quality Based on the Appearance Characteristic Recognition
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The detection of peanut cultivars and quality is an important composition of peanut breeding and quality testing. In order to evaluate the feasibility of mass peanut seed detecting via appearance characteristic, firstly we get 48 varieties pictures and 6 different quality in one variety pictures with digital camera, then we use the method of principle component analysis and artificial neural network to establish a seed recognition model which is made up of 49 distinct appearance characteristic refers to shape, texture, color and optimize the model. The testing result indicates: after the model optimization, the variety recognition rate and quality recognition rate reaches 91.2% and 93.0% respectively; the color characteristic plays an impactful role in the variety and quality detection; the appearance characteristic distinguishes quality is more obvious than distinguishes varieties. The detecting method based on the machine vision possesses the cost and speed advantages, it can be used in the identification for peanut cultivars and quality.

articleTitle: Research on Characters of Operations in EMS Base on Clustering Techniques
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: EMS service is an important operation in China Post and is growing fast in the past years. At the same time, there are tremendous competitions for EMS service, which requires China Post to improve on present service based on well knowing the characters of the service. In this study, different clustering models are built by using different clustering techniques of K-means algorithm and two-step method and confirming number of the clusters as 2 and 4, then the characters of the clusters are analyzed, in particular, the general characters of the all EMS services are pointed out, finally, some advices are put forward.

articleTitle: Study and Realization of Construction Project Bidding System Based on XML and AHP-GRAM
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper adopts XML technology to establish standard development of electronic tender, for which format is not unified in traditional construction project bidding system. In view the defects of subjective existing in traditional system, a model of construction project bidding system based on AHP-GRAM is put forward in this paper, which fully embody the important influence of indexes in the evaluation process, and finally realization scientific evaluation. Based on the above work, an bidding system for construction project is developed by the supporting techniques such as C#, XML and Web. The three-layer architecture of this system is constructed and its working flow is given. Its performance shows the feasibility and effectiveness of this system and provides important reference for the computer aided bidding system for construction project.

articleTitle: Structure-Preserving Simulation of the Lotka-Volterra System
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The Lotka-Volterra system is traditionally integrated with the classical Runge-Kutta method of order four or the Runge-Kutta-Fehlberg method which fails to preserve the special structure of the system in long term integration. This paper transforms the Lotka-Volterra system into a Hamiltonian system and integrates it with two highly efficient symplectic methods. The results of the numerical simulation show the robustness of these methods.

articleTitle: Wind-Induced Response Analysis of Wind Turbine System
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper, the dynamic response of wind turbine system under wind action is numerically investigated. First, the random Fourier spectrum and rotating Fourier spectrum are proposed in this paper. These dynamic excitation models are built by starting with the point of view of random function and combining the understanding of the physical mechanism of the random excitations. Then a wind-induced analysis of 1.25 MW wind turbine system is carried out. The wind force records on the wind turbine tower and blades come from the random Fourier spectrum and rotating Fourier spectrum respectively. The results show that the wind-induced response of wind turbine system is remarkable and usually is the dominant factor in the design of wind turbine system.

articleTitle: Research of Intrusion Detection Based on Principal Components Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The effective way of improving the efficiency of intrusion detection is to reduce the heavy data process workload. In this paper, the dimensionality reduction use of technology in the classic dimensionality reduction algorithm principal component to analysis large-scale data source for reduced-made features of the original data be retained and improved the efficiency of intrusion detection. And use BP neural network training the data after dimensionality reduction, will be effective in normal and abnormal data distinction, and achieved good results.

articleTitle: Research on a Supporting Platform for Virtual Testing System Based on RTX
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Communication and information services are the important parts of virtual test systematic supporting environment. With the background of a military virtual testing system, we have achieved a virtual testing platform for communication based on RT-TCP/IP and real-time database technology. In the communication level, we analyzed the real-time performance of RT-TCP/IP and demonstrated the feasibility of building the virtual test local area network which is agreed the RT-TCP/IP protocol; designed and implemented the middleware of RTEVSM (real-time Ethernet virtual shared memory). In the information services level, we analyzed the real-time performance of the RTX real-time operating sub-system, built a test database based on RTX memory database. By making a combination of the weapon system simulation test, we provided a specific design which satisfied the needs of various real-time applications.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of PROFIBUS Transmission Time Delay
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The PROFIBUS transmission time delay property has been studied. Based on the uniform transmission time delay model of fieldbus, the PROFIBUS general and simplified transmission time delay formulas were given, and the important aspects that influence transmission time delay, block time, frame time and respond time of receiver, were summarized. For the case that the address of the node which tries to send message is greater than that of the node which owns the token, PROFIBUS block time mathematical model was proposed, the structure of PROFIBUS block time was analyzed and the parameters which influence message block time were given. The correctness of block time mathematical model has been validated by the simulation. The job of this domain may process certain value for promoting the application and theoretical study of PROFIBUS.

articleTitle: Rapid Reconstruction Method to 2D-Profiles Feature
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The paper introduces a rapid and effective method to reconstruct 2D-profiles feature from data points. Firstly, the profiles point data are divided into lines points segments by incensement method, then fitting the points as lines saving lines parameters to line chain list; searching the line parameter chain list, if three are two continuous lines satisfy arc fitting conditions, computing the arc parameters by the two continuous lines, then saving the arc parameters to arc parameters chain list; searching arc parameters chin list, if there are two or more continuous arcs, turn these arcs to Bspline curves, profiles can be reconstructed by list feature elements, which benefits following surface reconstruction.

articleTitle: Application of 3D Finite Element Software in Web Cracking Analysis of Concrete Box-Girder Bridge
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: For a curved rigid bridge found vertical cracks in web during the construction process, the finite element software (MIDAS) was used to analysis for the creaking reason for the cast-in-place concrete box bridge. From the analysis of the objectives, the credibility of the results, foundation for modeling, the factors choice for the model and relevant experience are introduced. Including low strength and low elastic modulus of concrete, low grade concretes when the prestressing tendons stretched, longitudinal and vertical tendons excess stretched than the Code permission, as well as the combined effects of these factors results are described in detail, conclude that the poor quality of construction should be the cause of the cracks. By the web of concrete core drilling inspection found that there are more honeycomb holes in the web which is the direct cause of cracks and verified the finite element analysis results.

articleTitle: Study and Application of Geometrical Scale-Up Theoretical Model in Internal Mixer
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper, the geometrical similarity scale-up theoretical model of rotor structure in mixer is established according to the rheology theory of rubber mixing process .The mixer is designed by adoption of the model formula, using several geometrical proportional coefficients of which the solving method have been found .The designed mixer is compared with the prototype mixer, the results showed that the magnitude of error is acceptable from an engineering design standpoint. In order to validating this model, the experiments of large-scale machine with the same specification are finished, The quality of rubber compound is similar to the quality in the prototype mixer, the result of experiment data and regression analysis verified the obtained results and advantages of geometrical scale-up theoretical model.

articleTitle: An Improved Queue Management Algorithm in DiffServ Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Aimed at the DiffServ network system, this paper proposes an adaptive RIO algorithm in gentle mode (ARIO-G). The new algorithm integrates adaptive RED algorithm (ARED), RED algorithm in gentle mode (Gentle_RED) and RED algorithm with In/Out (RIO) effectively. By implementing an online automatic adjustment mechanism to achieve parameter setting, and introducing the new parameter 2maxp to deal with the situation when the average queue size is greater than the largest threshold, it aims at resolving the difficult parameter setting, the poor stability of average queue size and latency. The simulation results show that the algorithm resolves the problem of parameter setting, reduces the latency and the packet loss rate, and improves the stability of latency while maintaining the good protection of high-priority data packets in the RIO algorithm. Thus, it improves the performance of ensuring forwarding in DiffServ effectively.

articleTitle: Optimization of Networks Impedance Identification Based on Hybrid Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Based on matrix equations of spatial heating networks hydraulic calculation method, impedance identification equation is proposed which can be transformed into optimization problem solved by hybrid genetic algorithm. Then, impedance identification results of different numbers of operational conditions are quantitative compared by evaluation function values, which can be used to obtain the optimal number of operational conditions when the number of pressure measurement nodes is fixed. For the actual pressure measurement data has error, they are replaced by hydraulic calculation numerical simulation results to obtain more accurate identification comparison results. The above optimal processes are verified in case study and can be applied to actual heating networks.

articleTitle: The Research of Emergency Service Nodes Location Model Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: An approach for emergency service nodes location problem based on improved genetic algorithm is proposed. An optional model of the least emergency service nodes allocation by a deadline line is established, which is much more suitable for the actual emergency service nodes location. The genetic algorithm designed for location model is improved by the genetic seeds, which produce the original population and filial generation population. The example was given showing the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: The Finite Element Analysis of Pile-Anchor Support System in Foundation Pit
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper, pile-anchor support system of foundation pit is analyzed by ANSYS, which is the large scale general finite element analysis software. The stress and displacement of foundation pit and support system are available from ANSYS. On the basis of the finite element analysis results, traditional method is adopted to design and calculate the support system. Comparing the two results, the suitability of ANSYS in analyzing pile-anchor support of the foundation pit is testified. During the process of the analysis, according to the similarity of the soil condition, soil layers are simplified into two layers. The initial soil stress is simulated and introduced in the analysis, birth and death element is adopted to simulate the excavation of the foundation pit, the contact element is adopted to simulate the contact surface of the pile and soil, anchor and soil.

articleTitle: Study on Development of Pre-processing Program for FLAC^3D and Its Engineering Application of Numerical Simulation Calculation in Underground Cavern Group
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: FLAC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3D</sup> (Fast Lagrangian Analysis of Continua in 3 Dimensions), developed by Itasca Consulting Group Inc., USA, is widely used as computational package in the world. For some complex geologic problems, numerical models with FLAC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3D</sup> are difficult to construct. Therefore, a fast modeling method, which consists of building complicated numerical models with FLAC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3D</sup> by using ANSYS software, is put forward to define material properties, and for meshing. The interface program of ANSYS_TO_FLAC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3D</sup> is made by using Visual Fortran language in order to import the complicated model into FLAC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3D</sup>, thereby building a complicated model in FLAC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3D</sup>. Thus, two three dimensional numerical models of an underground caver group are developed. The case study shows the advantage and feasibility of above method on modeling and meshing. The result shows that the complicated FLAC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3D</sup> model is satisfactory. The greater computational power of FLAC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3D</sup> has been used and the utilities of both programs have been extended. This method of building complicated models with FLAC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3D</sup> may have some reference values.

articleTitle: The Research and Application of 2D and 3D Interactive System
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The disposal, modeling and visualization of 3D data are very important in the construction of digital earth. Now, one can get fine 3D model with software such as 3DMax and so on. But the 3D system is only perfect in visualization without any function of spatial analysis. The predominant software of GIS, for example, ArcGIS, or IMAGIS, provides ideal function of spatial analysis. One also can establish 3D models in the software, which are deficient in vividity. In addition, roving in the 3D system, the primary users always get lost without globe field of vision. The paper solved the problem by the 2D and 3D Interactive System. Based on the mature 3D software - SketchUp, the researcher got the elementary 3D model as the item input to the symbol database. Thus, the new system can produce 3D features in batches. The system chose ArcEngine as the developed tool. The 2D system played a role of EyeView. The basic functions, such as display, edit - add, delete took effect in both 2D and 3D system. Besides, the result of spatial analysis acquired in 2D system can be reflected in 3D system simultaneity. The case study was the 2D and 3D Interactive System of the ShanDong Jianzhu campus. The interface of each function has been shown at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Second Order Accuracy N-S Equations for Incompressible Flow
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Classical N-S equation is of first order accuracy in both time and space. First order scheme only includes first order terms, without the terms of second or higher order. These terms are relative to time and space intervals. As basic elements of fluid research, time and space intervals should be some finite quantities and not be infinitely near to zero as defined in mathematics. If the terms of second or higher order can be ignored depends on the value of related derivative multiplied. Compared with first order terms, the terms of second or higher order can be ignored under the condition of laminar flow. However, under the condition of turbulent flow, these canpsilat be ignored. When turbulent flow develops fully, first order terms, compared with second order terms, can be ignored. It is why classical N-S equations arenpsilat closed when they are used to analyze turbulent flow. On the basic, the second order accuracy N-S equations for incompressible fluid were derived.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting the Amount of Floating Population in Beijing Based on Grey Relational Analysis Model
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In recent years, the scale of the floating population in Beijing has shown explosive growth trends. The increase of the floating population accelerates the economic and social development of Beijing, but at the same time, puts forwards new problems for city management, social services and resources using. This paper builds grey relational analysis model, analyzes the factors affecting the amount of the floating population in Beijing, and brings forwards some resolvents for government decision-making departments reference.

articleTitle: The Study of Improved CamShift Algorithms for Goal Tacking in Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Design an improved CamShift tracking algorithm that based on the greedy algorithm, the algorithm can overcome CamShift algorithmpsilas defect that has high request to the initial location, which can greatly improve the tracking of moving objects in real time and reliability. The experimental results show that this modified CamShift approach is still effective in tracking the target with the complex circumstances.

articleTitle: Study on Grouts Flow in Rock Fracture and Numerical Simulation of Fracture Propagation
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this study, the solution for grouting pressure decay along the fracture with parallel walls of the Bingham grouts flow is analyzed. Also, by applying stress intensity factor, the fracture propagation under the grouting pressure is simulated through secondary development of large-scale finite element analysis software-ANSYS. At the same time, the magnitude of inlet volume grouting flow rate, grouting pressure and fracture aperture which influence the fracture propagation are analyzed too, which has significant guiding meaning to grouting theory and the practical grouting projects.

articleTitle: Integrated Approach and GIS Application for Planning and Management toward Poverty Alleviation: A Case Study on Iraq
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Urban poverty in Iraq, which is rapidly increasing, the number of Iraqis living below the poverty line has increased since the US-led invasion of Iraq in March 2003 to one-fifth of the population. This study aimed at showing how GIS tools and geostatistical techniques can be useful to develop structured databases for resource use modeling, planning and management geared to address poverty reduction. This information is applied to reconstruct the routes of poverty alleviation and to model the poverty process, coupled by the GIS (Geographical Information System) and statistical analyses. The use of GIS for poverty-related data handling is superior not only to manual (traditional) data handling methods, but advantageous over other information systems as it admits data coming from different sources.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research of Vibration Feeder Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Based on finite element method and ANSYS software, vibration feeder is fatigue break influenced by exciting force alternate load. This paper introduces the rational finite element model of vibration feeder. It discusses harmonic response analysis and discovers weak links which is angle steel junction of side plate, feed inlet and junction panel between no feed side plate and bottom plate then makes structure optimization. It provides streamlined method of optimum design of vibration feeder.

articleTitle: A New DAO Pattern with Dynamic Extensibility
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Currently existing data access object (DAO) patterns have several limitations. First, the interface of the patterns and business objects is tightly-coupled, which affects seriously the dynamic extensibility of software systems. Second, the patterns have duplicated implementation codes, which add to difficulties of system maintenance. To solve these problems, a new DAO pattern with stronger independency and dynamic extensibility is proposed in this paper. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the using process of the new DAO pattern. The greatest advantages of the new DAO pattern are as follows. If any business object is needed to add to the system, we donpsilat have to modify any codes of the class DAO Factory. All we need to do is to modify the mapping file. Furthermore, because we have only one DAO implementation class to accomplish all the data access to business objects, if some SQL statements are needed to be modified, all we need to do is to modify the DAO implementation class but not need to modify any business objects.

articleTitle: The Research on Risk Evaluation of Real Estate Development Project Based on RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: On the basis of setting up an evaluation index system for the development risk in real estate, this article designs an evaluation model for the development risk in real estate with RBF (radial basis function) neural network. Furthermore the training has been carried out for the neural network through selecting the risk evaluation data of several real estate development projects. The result shows that the model has higher accuracy and credibility and provides a new method for the risk evaluation in real estate development.

articleTitle: Usage-Centered Design for Government Websites - A Practical Analysis to Canada Government Website
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: According to the theory of usability engineer and information architecture, we should pay more attention to the two aspects in doing usage-centered design for government Website: how to make information clearer and easier to be understandable and how to deliver Information more expressively. A series of methods can enhance the usability of government Website. By analyzing Canada government Website, we can see how the theory and methodology can be applied in practice.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation and Die Optimal Design of a Large Diameter Thin-Walled Aluminum Profile Extrusion
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Extrusion process of a large diameter thin-walled aluminum profile was simulated by FEM based on Deform-3D software. The results show that the material flow velocity in the bearing exit of the original designed die is non-uniform. Three times modifications were performed and simulated. The optimal design with more uniform flow velocity in the bearing exit was obtained.

articleTitle: Research of the AP Optimize Method Based on Genetic Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: Based on simulated annealing genetic algorithm to optimize the AP method was proposed, the location and number of AP achieved to optimization, obtained the optimization goal of reaching the maximum coverage with at least number of AP. By improving the crossover to implement the optimal retain strategy, speed up the convergence of the algorithm and avoid a premature.

articleTitle: Optimal Observer Maneuver in Bearings-Only Tracking of Constant Acceleration Target
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper deals with the optimization of the observer trajectory when an observer tracks a constant acceleration target. First, optimal control theory is applied to establish the optimal maneuver model of an observer. Second, at range accuracy criterion, necessary conditions for optimal observer course are resolved by analytical means. Finally, the influence of observer speed target acceleration and initial target range on the optimal observer maneuver is discussed by simulation. Simulation results show that the optimal observer trajectory is almost smooth when near target moves at small acceleration and the observer should maneuver at high speed when tracking constant acceleration target accurately.

articleTitle: A Novel Four-Dimensional Hyperchaotic System and Its Dynamic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: This paper reports a new hyperchaotic system by adding an additional state variable into a three-dimensional chaotic dynamical system. Some of its basic dynamical properties, such as the hyperchaotic attractor, Lyapunov exponents, bifurcation diagram and the hyperchaotic attractor evolving into periodic, quasi-periodic dynamical behaviors by varying parameter k are studied. Numerical simulations are presented to show these results.

articleTitle: The Global Stability for a Vector-Host Epidemic Model
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: In this paper, a five-dimensional vector-host epidemic model with temporary immunity is studied. Applying autonomous convergence theorem, the basic reproduction number is proved to be a sharp threshold which completely determines the global dynamics and the outcome of the disease. If the reproduction number is less than or equal to one, the disease-free equilibrium is globally asymptotically stable in the feasible region and the disease always dies out. If the reproduction number is greater than one, a unique endemic equilibrium is globally asymptotically stable in the interior of the feasible region and the disease will persist at the endemic equilibrium if it is initially present.

articleTitle: Research on the Effect of Buffer's Properties on Train Longitudinal Impact
publicationTitle: 2009 Second International Conference on Information and Computing Science
abstract: The buffer's mechanical properties have important effect on train longitudinal impact. By analyzing factors that affect train longitudinal force, an integrated model of train longitudinal dynamics was established. On the basis of simulating the longitudinal dynamics of 5000 tons heavy-load train, research on the influence of the buffer's mechanical properties on train longitudinal dynamics was carried on. The results shown that the running distance, impedance force and capacity of buffer had decisive influence on train longitudinal impact; Enlarging the running distance of buffer properly was advantageous to release train longitudinal impact; Improving the impedance force unilateral could raise capacity of buffer, but it would also cause the increment of train longitudinal impact in service braking condition. The study results provide a certain basis for the buffer design and selection.
